# BC Observatory: Quality rules

> Microsoft's BCQuality knowledge base for AL (microsoft/BCQuality, MIT): each rule and review skill as a page with its own text,
> its good and bad examples, the objects and Learn pages it names and the pull requests that changed it. Frontmatter: schemas/frontmatter.guideline.json.

458 rules and review skills, by domain.

## performance

- [A FlowField needs a source-table key that covers its CalcFormula](microsoft/knowledge/performance/flowfield-source-key-needs-sumindexfields.md): A FlowField is computed by SQL on demand. (microsoft)
- [A page or lookup's effective filter may be defined outside the changed hunk](microsoft/knowledge/performance/page-effective-filter-may-live-outside-the-diff.md): The effective filter on a drill-down, lookup, or list result set is frequently defined outside any single changed hunk — on the table via a SourceTableView property or a TableRelation, or through SetRange/SetFilter calls in unchanged code that runs before the result is shown. (microsoft)
- [A primary-key Get() in a per-row helper is not an N+1 to cache manually](microsoft/knowledge/performance/primary-key-get-in-loop-is-transaction-cached.md): The Business Central server caches primary-key reads within a transaction. (microsoft)
- [Add trigger-only report fields in OnPreDataItem](microsoft/knowledge/performance/addloadfields-in-report-onpredataitem.md): Report dataitem field selection is calculated at compile time and once per dataitem type during execution. (microsoft)
- [Admin and migration pages tolerate lower performance discipline](microsoft/knowledge/performance/admin-and-migration-pages-tolerate-lower-perf.md): Some pages run rarely and against small datasets, and the upstream guidance explicitly calls for treating them as lower severity. (microsoft)
- [Aggregate source rows before persisting completed results](microsoft/knowledge/performance/aggregate-before-persisting-intermediate-results.md): A batch may repeatedly calculate the same group total while inserting and updating persistent working rows, even though only one completed result per group is needed. (microsoft)
- [AL auto-commits when code execution completes](microsoft/knowledge/performance/understand-implicit-transaction-boundary.md): In AL, write transactions are managed by the runtime, not by the developer. (microsoft)
- [AL boolean operators do not short-circuit](microsoft/knowledge/performance/boolean-operators-do-not-short-circuit.md): AL gives no short-circuit (lazy) evaluation guarantee for and, or, and xor: every operand of a boolean expression is evaluated, even when the leftmost operand already determines the result. (microsoft)
- [AL methods limited during write transactions: commit before RunModal and Codeunit.Run](microsoft/knowledge/performance/al-methods-limited-during-write-transactions.md): Once AL code has written to the database in the current transaction — an Insert, Modify, or Delete with no Commit since — the platform restricts four methods until that transaction is committed. (microsoft)
- [Apply early-exit guards before calling Get](microsoft/knowledge/performance/apply-guards-before-get.md): A Get (or any other database call) executed before a guard that may exit the procedure does a round-trip the procedure never uses. (microsoft)
- [Apply SetRange/SetFilter before iterating, not as an if-test inside the loop](microsoft/knowledge/performance/apply-filters-before-iterating.md): A SetRange or SetFilter placed before FindSet narrows the result set at the database. (microsoft)
- [Avoid cloning records before Modify or Delete in loops](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-cloning-records-before-modify-delete-in-loops.md): Microsoft's AL database-method performance guidance states that cloning an iterated record before Modify or Delete restarts the SQL SELECT and issues an extra SQL statement for every row. (microsoft)
- [Avoid Get / FindFirst inside a loop on a large inner table](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-get-inside-loop-on-large-table.md): A Get or FindFirst against another persistent table inside a loop can produce an N+1 access pattern: one outer query followed by repeated inner lookups. (microsoft)
- [Avoid growing globals in SingleInstance subscribers](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-growing-globals-in-singleinstance-subscribers.md): A codeunit with SingleInstance = true is allocated once per session and lives until the session ends. (microsoft)
- [Avoid RecordRef / FieldRef in hot loops when a typed record fits](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-recordref-in-hot-loop.md): RecordRef and FieldRef are slower than direct typed record access — the platform resolves the table and field at runtime instead of at compile time. (microsoft)
- [Avoid repeating validation when its inputs have not changed](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-repeating-unchanged-validation.md): Validate runs field validation logic, which can invoke subscribers and additional reads or writes even if the assigned value is unchanged. (microsoft)
- [Batch number-series calls instead of GetNextNo per insert](microsoft/knowledge/performance/batch-number-series-instead-of-getnextno-per-row.md): Codeunit "No. (microsoft)
- [CalcFields in both OnAfterGetRecord and OnAfterGetCurrRecord is not redundant](microsoft/knowledge/performance/calcfields-in-both-getrecord-triggers-is-not-redundant.md): OnAfterGetRecord fires once per row as the page loads records into the view; OnAfterGetCurrRecord fires when a record becomes the active/current record. (microsoft)
- [Calculate expensive cues on a page background task](microsoft/knowledge/performance/page-background-tasks-for-expensive-cues.md): Role-center cues and CardPart totals that run CalcFields, scans, or HTTP on the UI thread freeze the shell until they finish. (microsoft)
- [Choose MaintainSIFTIndex by read-write ratio](microsoft/knowledge/performance/choose-maintainsiftindex-by-read-write-ratio.md): MaintainSIFTIndex on a key decides whether SQL Server maintains the SIFT indexed view as underlying rows change. (microsoft)
- [Commit before Codeunit.Run when the caller already holds a write transaction](microsoft/knowledge/performance/codeunit-run-requires-prior-commit-inside-transaction.md): Codeunit.Run cannot nest inside an open write transaction. (microsoft)
- [Compute data-driven Role Center headlines in the background, not when the page opens](microsoft/knowledge/performance/compute-role-center-headlines-in-the-background.md): Code in a headline part's OnOpenPage, or in a subscriber to an event raised from it, runs every time the Role Center opens. (microsoft)
- [Database work in OnAfterGetCurrRecord is not a per-row or N+1 cost](microsoft/knowledge/performance/onaftergetcurrrecord-is-not-per-row.md): OnAfterGetCurrRecord fires only when the current/active record changes — typically once when the page opens and once each time the user selects a different row — not once for every row rendered in a list. (microsoft)
- [Design a read-pattern key and verify whether it covers the query](microsoft/knowledge/performance/design-covering-keys-from-read-pattern.md): A secondary key should serve a particular read, not a list of fields that happen to look important. (microsoft)
- [Do not call ChangeCompany inside a per-row loop](microsoft/knowledge/performance/changecompany-in-loop-drops-caches.md): ChangeCompany retargets a record variable to another company's data and drops the in-memory caches bound to the previous company. (microsoft)
- [Do not call CurrPage.Update inside OnAfterGetRecord](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-currpage-update-in-onaftergetrecord.md): OnAfterGetRecord on a list already runs once per visible row on scroll and refresh. (microsoft)
- [Do not call HttpClient inside an open write transaction](microsoft/knowledge/performance/httpclient-inside-write-transaction-holds-locks.md): The first database write opens an AL write transaction that the runtime holds until the execution completes or Commit() runs — see understand-implicit-transaction-boundary.md. (microsoft)
- [Do not Commit inside loops](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-commit-inside-loops.md): Commit ends the current write transaction. (microsoft)
- [Do not Get the record the page already loaded](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-redundant-get-when-record-already-loaded.md): A list or card page's OnAfterGetRecord trigger fires *because* the platform has already fetched a row into Rec. (microsoft)
- [Do not hold locks while waiting for the user](microsoft/knowledge/performance/avoid-user-prompts-inside-transactions.md): A Confirm, StrMenu, or other user prompt issued from inside a write transaction stalls the transaction — and therefore every lock it holds — until the user responds. (microsoft)
- [Do not LockTable in a read-only procedure](microsoft/knowledge/performance/do-not-locktable-in-read-only-procedure.md): LockTable is a transaction-wide signal: from the call onward, every read against that table in the same transaction acquires UPDLOCK. (microsoft)
- [Do not Modify inside OnAfterGetRecord](microsoft/knowledge/performance/do-not-modify-in-onaftergetrecord.md): A list page's OnAfterGetRecord fires once per visible row, every time the user scrolls, sorts, or refreshes. (microsoft)
- [Document reports should default to a Word layout, not RDLC](microsoft/knowledge/performance/document-report-word-layout.md): For a document report — an invoice, statement, order confirmation, or any report meant to be printed, emailed, or exported as a single-record document — Microsoft's own guidance recommends a Word rendering layout over RDLC: "RDL layouts can result in slower performance with document reports,… (microsoft)
- [Enforced singleton setup tables need no access optimization](microsoft/knowledge/performance/singleton-setup-tables-need-no-access-optimization.md): An access-pattern exemption is valid only for a table whose schema and write paths enforce at most one row for the relevant scope. (microsoft)
- [FindSet(true) applies UpdLock on the read; the two-parameter form is obsolete](microsoft/knowledge/performance/findset-true-applies-updlock-on-read.md): FindSet() and FindSet(false) are read-only — no locking. (microsoft)
- [Guard event subscribers with cheap checks before any database call](microsoft/knowledge/performance/guard-event-subscribers-before-db-call.md): Event subscribers fire on every event matching their signature — for OnAfterValidateEvent on a hot field like Sales Line.Quantity, that is every quantity edit by every user. (microsoft)
- [Guard page trigger work with GuiAllowed for OData and Excel](microsoft/knowledge/performance/guiallowed-guard-on-pages-used-as-odata.md): Pages exposed as OData, including Edit in Excel, still run AL page triggers for every row returned. (microsoft)
- [Hidden page FlowFields still calculate unless visible-only calculation is enabled](microsoft/knowledge/performance/hidden-flowfields-still-calculate-before-bc26-opt-in.md): By default, a FlowField used directly as a page control's source is calculated when the page loads even when Visible = false or its visibility expression evaluates to false. (microsoft)
- [IsEmpty immediately before FindSet is an extra round-trip](microsoft/knowledge/performance/isempty-before-findset-is-extra-round-trip.md): IsEmpty is the right API when the caller only needs existence — see microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-isempty-for-existence-check.md. (microsoft)
- [Job queue external effects must be idempotent](microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-external-effects-must-be-idempotent.md): A job queue handler can successfully create something in an external system and then fail while updating Business Central. (microsoft)
- [Job queue handlers must not require user interaction](microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-handlers-must-not-require-ui.md): A job queue handler runs in a background session with no client UI. (microsoft)
- [Job queue handlers must propagate execution failures](microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-handlers-must-propagate-failures.md): The job queue dispatcher can mark an entry as failed, record the error, and apply its configured retry behavior only when the handler terminates with an error. (microsoft)
- [Justify low-selectivity fields in key columns](microsoft/knowledge/performance/justify-low-selectivity-fields-in-key-columns.md): A Boolean, small Option/Enum, or status field (Processed, Blocked, Status) in a key is a cost that needs a reason. (microsoft)
- [Keep eligible inserts together instead of re-reading their target](microsoft/knowledge/performance/preserve-buffered-inserts-by-separating-target-reads.md): Business Central can automatically buffer eligible Insert calls. (microsoft)
- [Load common fields before branching on case](microsoft/knowledge/performance/load-common-fields-before-branching-on-case.md): When a known input determines which fields a subsequent record read will use, a single SetLoadFields containing every branch's fields loads unnecessary columns. (microsoft)
- [Load only primary key fields for reference work](microsoft/knowledge/performance/load-only-primary-key-fields-for-reference-work.md): Work that uses a record only for its identity — passing it to another procedure that will re-fetch what it needs, queueing a key for later processing, running existence checks, or building a reference collection — does not need non-key payload fields. (microsoft)
- [MaintainSQLIndex = false on a key disables SIFT for FlowFields that depend on it](microsoft/knowledge/performance/maintainsqlindex-false-breaks-flowfield-sift.md): MaintainSQLIndex = false on a key tells the platform not to materialize that key as a SQL index. (microsoft)
- [Order case branches by frequency](microsoft/knowledge/performance/order-case-branches-by-frequency.md): AL documentation does not guarantee that a case statement uses a linear comparison strategy, so branch frequency alone is not proof of a performance issue. (microsoft)
- [Pass false to Insert/Modify/Delete when the table triggers do not need to fire](microsoft/knowledge/performance/pass-false-to-insert-when-trigger-not-needed.md): Insert(true), Modify(true), and Delete(true) run the table's OnInsert/OnModify/OnDelete trigger; the (false) form skips it. (microsoft)
- [Pass the iterated record var so a JIT load updates the enumerator](microsoft/knowledge/performance/pass-var-record-to-preserve-partial-load-enumerator.md): A FindSet/Next loop builds an enumerator from the fields selected for load. (microsoft)
- [Point lookups at a dedicated lookup page, not the full list](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-dedicated-lookup-pages-not-full-lists.md): A TableRelation lookup opens the table's LookupPageId. (microsoft)
- [Prefer a Dictionary over a temporary table for pure lookups](microsoft/knowledge/performance/prefer-dictionary-over-temporary-table-for-lookups.md): An AL Dictionary directly models an unordered unique key-to-value collection. (microsoft)
- [Prefer a related table over stored fields on hot ledgers](microsoft/knowledge/performance/prefer-related-table-over-extension-on-hot-ledgers.md): Since v23, all extensions on the same base table share at most one companion-table join, and the platform automatically excludes that join on List, ListPart, and OData pages when partial records are in effect and no extension field is loaded. (microsoft)
- [Prefer ReadIsolation over LockTable for read-only scenarios](microsoft/knowledge/performance/prefer-readisolation-over-locktable-for-reads.md): Without read scale-out, LockTable causes subsequent reads of that table in the transaction to use UPDLOCK. (microsoft)
- [Putting a job queue entry on hold does not stop its current run](microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-on-hold-does-not-stop-running-work.md): The On Hold status prevents a job queue entry from starting again, but it does not cancel a run that is already in process. (microsoft)
- [Query results bypass the primary-key cache](microsoft/knowledge/performance/query-results-bypass-primary-key-cache.md): The Business Central server caches primary-key Get calls within a transaction. (microsoft)
- [Removing SourceTableTemporary on an API page switches it from in-memory to persistent](microsoft/knowledge/performance/do-not-remove-sourcetabletemporary-from-api-page.md): SourceTableTemporary = true on a page makes the page's record buffer in-memory only — reads and writes do not touch SQL. (microsoft)
- [Reset and empty SetLoadFields restore a full-row load](microsoft/knowledge/performance/reset-clears-partial-record-selection.md): SetLoadFields(...) sticks to the record variable until something clears it. (microsoft)
- [Reuse repeated filtered results within a correct cache scope](microsoft/knowledge/performance/cache-repeated-filtered-results-with-explicit-scope.md): A loop can ask the same filtered existence or calculation question for many rows sharing a business key, or two phases can ask it for the same rows. (microsoft)
- [Review overlapping keys as a portfolio](microsoft/knowledge/performance/review-overlapping-keys-before-adding-an-index.md): Adding a secondary key to a frequently written table maintains another SQL index for every affected write. (microsoft)
- [Session-open subscribers must not do I/O](microsoft/knowledge/performance/oncompanyopen-subscribers-must-not-do-io.md): OnCompanyOpen, OnCompanyOpenCompleted, and System Initialization.OnAfterLogin run while the session is being created. (microsoft)
- [Set DataAccessIntent ReadOnly on analytical objects](microsoft/knowledge/performance/dataaccessintent-readonly-on-analytical-objects.md): DataAccessIntent was introduced at runtime 5.0 (BC 16) and has no effect in earlier versions. (microsoft)
- [SetCurrentKey is not a SQL index hint for record reads](microsoft/knowledge/performance/setcurrentkey-sets-sort-order-not-index-hint.md): A common misconception is that SetCurrentKey tells SQL Server which index to use for a filtered FindSet/FindFirst query. (microsoft)
- [Skip SetLoadFields on write and copy paths](microsoft/knowledge/performance/skip-setloadfields-on-write-and-transferfields.md): SetLoadFields is a read optimization. (microsoft)
- [Store the scheduled task ID to avoid duplicate tasks](microsoft/knowledge/performance/store-scheduled-task-id-to-avoid-duplicate-tasks.md): Every call to TaskScheduler.CreateTask creates a new scheduled task and returns its unique GUID. (microsoft)
- [Temporary tables avoid SQL I/O, not in-memory work](microsoft/knowledge/performance/temporary-tables-have-no-database-cost.md): A temporary table stores its rows in Business Central Server memory instead of a physical SQL table. (microsoft)
- [Triggers, subscribers, and media fields can silently regress ModifyAll / DeleteAll](microsoft/knowledge/performance/triggers-and-media-field-regress-modifyall.md): ModifyAll and DeleteAll can limit SQL calls, but Microsoft documents that they revert to individual calls when the table has trigger code, related modify/delete/global/database event subscribers, active security filtering, Media or MediaSet fields, or fields added through companion tables. (microsoft)
- [Use \[TryFunction\] for error catching, Codeunit.Run for atomic rollback](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-tryfunction-for-error-catching-not-rollback.md): \[TryFunction\] lets a caller catch an error, but database changes made before that error are not rolled back. (microsoft)
- [Use a grouped query for distinct values and duplicate detection](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-grouped-query-for-distinct-values-and-duplicates.md): The AL Record type has no SELECT DISTINCT or GROUP BY ... (microsoft)
- [Use a job queue category to serialize conflicting jobs](microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-category-code-serializes-conflicting-jobs.md): Different job queue entries can run at the same time. (microsoft)
- [Use AL TextBuilder for repeated text mutation](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-textbuilder-for-string-concatenation-in-loops.md): AL TextBuilder is a reference type intended for modifying text without creating a new Text value for each change. (microsoft)
- [Use CalcSums for stored-field totals, not as a shortcut for FlowFields](microsoft/knowledge/performance/calcsums-instead-of-calcfields-in-loop.md): CalcFields evaluates a FlowField for one record; CalcSums totals stored numeric fields in a filtered source table. (microsoft)
- [Use case true of for long chains of dependent conditions](microsoft/knowledge/performance/case-true-of-for-long-condition-chains.md): Because AL gives no short-circuit guarantee for and and or, a chain of conditions that must be evaluated in order has to be sequenced with nested if statements — and past three conditions the nesting itself becomes the problem: the body drifts right, the order of evaluation is carried by… (microsoft)
- [Use Codeunit.Run to bound an atomic sub-operation](microsoft/knowledge/performance/codeunit-run-as-atomic-sub-operation.md): Codeunit.Run(ID) is the AL-idiomatic way to run a unit of work as an atomic sub-operation with its own transactional boundary. (microsoft)
- [Use DeleteAll for filtered bulk deletion](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-deleteall-for-filtered-bulk-deletion.md): DeleteAll(false) is eligible for a set-based SQL delete with the record variable's filters applied, but it is not guaranteed to stay one statement. (microsoft)
- [Use FindSet with repeat..Next; do not pair FindFirst/FindLast/Get with Next](microsoft/knowledge/performance/pair-findset-with-next-loop.md): Two CodeCop rules carve out the loop pattern. (microsoft)
- [Use Get for primary-key lookups without losing filter conditions](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-get-instead-of-findfirst-on-full-primary-key.md): Get(...) retrieves a record by primary key, but ignores normal record filters. (microsoft)
- [Use IsEmpty for existence checks, not Count() or FindFirst()](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-isempty-for-existence-check.md): When the caller only needs to know whether any row matches a filter, IsEmpty() is the API designed for the question. (microsoft)
- [Use ModifyAll only for equivalent bulk assignments](microsoft/knowledge/performance/prefer-modifyall-over-per-row-modify.md): ModifyAll assigns one value to one field across the filtered set. (microsoft)
- [Use SetAutoCalcFields when each iterated row needs a FlowField](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-setautocalcfields-for-per-row-flowfields.md): Record.SetAutoCalcFields has been available since runtime 1.0 and makes the specified FlowFields calculate as records are retrieved. (microsoft)
- [Use SetLoadFields to load only the fields the code reads](microsoft/knowledge/performance/use-setloadfields-for-partial-records.md): SetLoadFields(...) declares the subset of normal fields the next read should materialize. (microsoft)
- [Validate on a partial record forces JIT loads](microsoft/knowledge/performance/validate-on-partial-record-forces-jit.md): Validate runs the field's OnValidate trigger and TableRelation lookups. (microsoft)

## ui

- [A `DropDown` field remains hidden when its lookup-page control is hidden](microsoft/knowledge/ui/dropdown-fieldgroup-respects-lookup-page-visibility.md): A tableextension can append a field to the DropDown field group with addlast, but the client still omits that field when its control on the underlying lookup page has Visible = false. (microsoft)
- [A notification that must be recalled needs an Id the code can find again](microsoft/knowledge/ui/notification-recall-needs-known-id.md): Notification.Recall() withdraws the notification whose Id it carries. (microsoft)
- [A page field bound to a table field inherits that field's ToolTip](microsoft/knowledge/ui/bound-page-field-inherits-source-field-tooltip.md): Starting with BC24 (2024 release wave 1), runtime 13.0 supports ToolTip on table fields. (microsoft)
- [Control add-in accessibility is the developer's responsibility](microsoft/knowledge/ui/control-add-in-accessibility-is-developer-responsibility.md): When a developer builds a JavaScript control add-in, they bypass the Business Central framework's built-in accessibility support and take full responsibility for the accessibility of the rendered HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. (microsoft)
- [Control add-ins cannot use BC color tokens or theming](microsoft/knowledge/ui/control-add-in-has-no-bc-color-tokens.md): A JavaScript control add-in has no access to Business Central's color tokens or theming system. (microsoft)
- [Cosmetic styles need no textual context](microsoft/knowledge/ui/cosmetic-styles-need-no-textual-context.md): A field's Style property controls text formatting. (microsoft)
- [Default descending sort on historical pages](microsoft/knowledge/ui/default-descending-sort-on-historical-pages.md): Historical list pages should default to showing the newest records first. (microsoft)
- [Filter ListPart FactBoxes With SubPageLink To The Parent Record](microsoft/knowledge/ui/factbox-design.md): A FactBox is a page part that surfaces related data beside the main record so users avoid navigating away. (microsoft)
- [Gate Role Center content by permission with AccessByPermission](microsoft/knowledge/ui/rolecenter-permission-gating-must-use-accessbypermission.md): A page of type RoleCenter cannot have triggers (AL0378, error) or procedures (AL0569, warning that will become an error), and the AL compiler applies both rules to a pageextension whose target is a Role Center. (microsoft)
- [Grid and fixed-layout data-table heuristic](microsoft/knowledge/ui/grid-data-table-heuristic.md): Business Central renders grid() and fixed() layouts in two modes. (microsoft)
- [Group caption quality is not an accessibility issue](microsoft/knowledge/ui/group-caption-quality-is-not-an-accessibility-issue.md): Group captions affect page organization, but missing, generic, or duplicate group captions are not accessibility violations per the BC accessibility rules. (microsoft)
- [Group ShowCaption = false outside grid/fixed is a layout choice](microsoft/knowledge/ui/group-show-caption-false-outside-grid-is-not-a-violation.md): In a standard Card or Document page, a group with ShowCaption = false is a layout choice, not an accessibility violation. (microsoft)
- [Group-labeled first child exception](microsoft/knowledge/ui/group-labeled-first-child-exception.md): ShowCaption = false is acceptable on an editable field only when all of the following conditions are met: (microsoft)
- [Layout-table grids with visible captions are valid](microsoft/knowledge/ui/layout-table-with-captions-is-valid.md): A grid or fixed layout that does not meet all three data-table conditions renders as a layout table. (microsoft)
- [Load packaged control add-in resources with credentialed AJAX](microsoft/knowledge/ui/control-addin-package-resource-ajax-needs-withcredentials.md): JavaScript in a Business Central control add-in can load a static resource from its extension package with AJAX, but the request needs the Business Central context and cookies. (microsoft)
- [Mark code-required page fields with ShowMandatory](microsoft/knowledge/ui/showmandatory-on-code-required-page-fields.md): ShowMandatory draws the red asterisk on a page field and, per the platform documentation, enforces no validation. (microsoft)
- [Nested grids are not supported](microsoft/knowledge/ui/no-nested-grids.md): A grid nested inside another grid is not a supported pattern in Business Central. (microsoft)
- [Offload Slow Read-Only Page Calculations To Background Tasks](microsoft/knowledge/ui/page-background-tasks.md): Pages that compute statistics, aggregates, or external lookups inline block the page from rendering until the calculation finishes, producing a visible freeze on FactBoxes, cue tiles, and calculated fields. (microsoft)
- [OnDrillDown on non-editable fields renders as a link](microsoft/knowledge/ui/on-drill-down-on-non-editable-fields-renders-as-link.md): The Business Central client renders non-editable fields that have an OnDrillDown trigger as HTML <a> (anchor) elements. (microsoft)
- [Open documents from a mixed-type list through Page Management](microsoft/knowledge/ui/list-page-document-routing-uses-page-management.md): Some tables back several document pages, chosen by a type field. (microsoft)
- [Page client-expression properties must not use an `in \[...\]` list](microsoft/knowledge/ui/page-client-expression-must-not-use-in-list.md): Enabled, Visible, Editable, and StyleExpr on page controls (the list is not exhaustive; HideValue is rejected the same way) can be bound to a client expression instead of a literal. (microsoft)
- [Pages must match one of Business Central's page-type conventions](microsoft/knowledge/ui/page-design-must-match-bc-page-type-conventions.md): Business Central's page types — RoleCenter, Card, List, CardPart, ListPart, Worksheet, Document, ListPlus, plus system dialog/special types such as NavigatePage, ConfirmationDialog, StandardDialog, HeadlinePart, and API (a selected list of conventional types this article covers design conventions… (microsoft)
- [Preserve list scope after `SetSelectionFilter`](microsoft/knowledge/ui/set-selection-filter-list-scope.md): CurrPage.SetSelectionFilter(Rec) behaves differently depending on whether the user explicitly multi-selected rows. (microsoft)
- [Promote Actions With The Modern `actionref` Syntax, Never The Legacy `Promoted` Properties](microsoft/knowledge/ui/prefer-actionref-syntax-for-promoted-actions.md): Business Central 2022 release wave 2 (v21) introduced the area(Promoted) block with actionref as the way to promote page actions, separating an action's definition from its promotion. (microsoft)
- [Semantic styles in a cuegroup are auto-labeled](microsoft/knowledge/ui/semantic-style-in-cuegroup-exception.md): Fields inside a cuegroup render as cue tiles. (microsoft)
- [Semantic styles need independent textual meaning](microsoft/knowledge/ui/semantic-styles-need-independent-textual-meaning.md): Three Style values carry semantic meaning through color and must be backed by text that conveys the same meaning: (microsoft)
- [Sentence-phrase captions use sentence case, not title case](microsoft/knowledge/ui/caption-capitalization-noun-phrase-vs-sentence-phrase.md): Business Central caption capitalization depends on whether the caption reads as a noun phrase or a sentence/verb phrase. (microsoft)
- [Serialize control add-in AL calls and keep payloads small](microsoft/knowledge/ui/control-addin-throttle-al-calls-and-payload-size.md): InvokeExtensibilityMethod crosses from a control add-in into the Business Central service. (microsoft)
- [Set Field Importance To Drive FastTab Progressive Disclosure](microsoft/knowledge/ui/fasttab-field-importance.md): A FastTab field's Importance property controls whether the field is visible immediately, hidden behind "Show more", or surfaced on the collapsed FastTab header summary line. (microsoft)
- [ShowCaption = false on non-editable fields](microsoft/knowledge/ui/show-caption-false-allowed-on-non-editable-fields.md): When a field is explicitly non-editable (Editable = false), it serves as content rather than as a form field. (microsoft)
- [ShowCaption in a PromptDialog prompt area](microsoft/knowledge/ui/show-caption-in-promptdialog-prompt-area.md): On PageType = PromptDialog pages, input fields inside area(Prompt) are labeled by the dialog's heading — the page Caption. (microsoft)
- [ShowCaption inside a repeater is harmless](microsoft/knowledge/ui/show-caption-in-repeater-allowed.md): Fields inside a repeater() control are labeled by their column headers, not by their own captions. (microsoft)
- [ShowCaption on editable fields](microsoft/knowledge/ui/show-caption-on-editable-fields.md): ShowCaption must remain true (the default) on editable fields unless the field matches one of the officially supported "magic patterns". (microsoft)
- [Standalone content in a layout-table grid](microsoft/knowledge/ui/standalone-content-in-layout-table.md): A non-editable field with ShowCaption = false is acceptable inside a layout-table grid only when the field is standalone content — it displays a value that is meaningful on its own (for example a status message or a description) and is not intended to label or be labeled by another field in the… (microsoft)
- [StyleExpr: Boolean toggle vs Text variable](microsoft/knowledge/ui/style-expr-text-vs-boolean.md): StyleExpr on a page field serves two distinct purposes depending on its type: (microsoft)
- [Tabular intent requires data-table conditions](microsoft/knowledge/ui/tabular-intent-requires-data-table-conditions.md): The most common accessibility bug in grid layouts is partially following the data-table conventions. (microsoft)
- [Use `UpdatePropagation = Both` when line edits must refresh the main page](microsoft/knowledge/ui/updatepropagation-both-refreshes-main-page.md): A page part does not automatically refresh its parent page when the subpage changes. (microsoft)
- [Use Standard Promoted Action Group Names And Placements](microsoft/knowledge/ui/promoted-action-groups.md): Business Central ships a fixed vocabulary of promoted action groups, and users build muscle memory around where each kind of action lives. (microsoft)
- [Validate request-page input in OnQueryClosePage, not only in OnPreReport](microsoft/knowledge/ui/validate-request-page-input-in-onqueryclosepage.md): OnPreReport runs after the request page has closed and before the data items are processed. (microsoft)

## data-modeling

- [`Round` direction symbols follow magnitude, not mathematical ordering](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/round-direction-symbols-use-magnitude.md): AL's Round(Number, Precision, Direction) uses '>' to round away from zero and '<' to round toward zero. (microsoft)
- [`ValidateTableRelation = false` suppresses rename propagation, not just input validation](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/validate-table-relation-false-suppresses-rename-propagation.md): Renaming a record updates it in all other locations that reference it through a TableRelation, with no code. (microsoft)
- [`xRec` is a before-image in `OnRename` and `OnDelete`, but mirrors `Rec` in `OnInsert` and `OnModify` from code](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/xrec-is-a-before-image-only-in-some-triggers.md): xRec is widely believed to be "the previous record" inside every table trigger, and — in reaction to that — is often dismissed with the folk rule *"xRec only works from a page, never from code"*. (microsoft)
- [A document's own Print/Email actions call Report Selections directly; Document Sending Profile is scoped to Post-and-Send](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/document-print-and-email-actions-call-report-selections-directly.md): table 60 "Document Sending Profile" is not a general gateway for every print/email path — it exists specifically for the combined Post and Send action: "You can set each customer up with a preferred method of sending sales documents, so that you do not have to select a sending option every time… (microsoft)
- [A master table's `No.` primary key comes from a number series in `OnInsert`](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/master-table-no-from-number-series-in-oninsert.md): In Business Central, a master table (Customer, Vendor, Item, and any custom equivalent) uses a single primary-key field named No. (microsoft)
- [A new price source needs both a calculation candidate and a recalculation trigger](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/new-price-source-must-add-candidate-and-trigger-recalculation.md): Making a custom field usable as a price source on a sales line is two separate, independent pieces of wiring, and doing only one produces a line that looks like it's using the new source without ever actually being priced by it. (microsoft)
- [A setup table is a singleton: one blank-keyed row, no insert or delete](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/setup-table-is-a-singleton.md): An application-area setup table (Sales & Receivables Setup, Inventory Setup, and any custom * Setup) holds exactly one record per company. (microsoft)
- [A table that owns dependent records must delete them in `OnDelete`](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/owning-table-must-delete-dependents-in-ondelete.md): TableRelation looks like referential integrity but only performs lookup and input validation. (microsoft)
- [A TableRelation field's length must match the related field](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/tablerelation-field-length-must-match-related-field.md): TableRelation points a field at another table, or at a specific field of it with Table.Field. (microsoft)
- [Activate a new Price Calculation Handler through OnFindSupportedSetup, not just by implementing it](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/activate-new-price-calculation-handler-via-onfindsupportedsetup.md): enum 7011 "Price Calculation Handler" (implements "Price Calculation") is how a new pricing engine plugs into Business Central — extend the enum with a value pointing at a codeunit that implements the Price Calculation interface. (microsoft)
- [After Ship-and-Invoice posting, Item Ledger Entry carries the shipment document number](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/item-ledger-entry-document-no-follows-last-shipping-no.md): Posting a sales order with both Ship and Invoice in one call creates the Item Ledger Entry during the shipment leg of that combined post, so the entry's Document No. (microsoft)
- [An insert-only transfer routine may rely on cleanup its caller already performed](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/insert-only-transfer-may-rely-on-caller-cleanup.md): A routine that copies rows from a template table into a target table — a TransferX procedure filling comment, dimension, or attribute lines from a standard-task or template record — is frequently written as filter-and-insert with no DeleteAll of its own. (microsoft)
- [Application code must not change the WorkDate](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/code-must-not-change-workdate.md): The work date is a per-user session setting the user controls from the client (the date shown in the top-right corner, used to default posting dates and date filters). (microsoft)
- [Assign numbers with codeunit `"No. Series"`, not the obsolete `NoSeriesManagement`](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/use-no-series-codeunit-not-noseriesmanagement.md): Since 2023 release wave 1 (v22) the number-series API is codeunit 310 "No. (microsoft)
- [Business state must have a domain owner](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/business-state-must-have-a-domain-owner.md): Business Central's normal successful finalization removes a non-recurring Job Queue Entry. (microsoft)
- [Calculate a BLOB field before reading its stream](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/calcfields-blob-before-reading-its-stream.md): Get, Find, FindSet, and Next do not load the content of Blob fields. (microsoft)
- [Code that calculates a unit price rounds it to the currency's Unit-Amount Rounding Precision](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/round-calculated-unit-prices-to-unit-amount-precision.md): Business Central rounds a unit price only where its own code computes one, above all in the standard price calculation. (microsoft)
- [Create master records with `Insert(true)` unless the caller does the trigger's work itself](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/master-data-must-be-inserted-with-trigger.md): Record.Insert() does not run OnInsert: RunTrigger defaults to false. (microsoft)
- [Custom document dispatch must not bypass Report Selections](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/custom-document-dispatch-must-not-bypass-report-selections.md): A codeunit that hardcodes which report to run (Report.RunModal(MyReportId, ...)), or builds its own email directly, instead of registering the document through table 77 "Report Selections" and calling its own Print/Email procedures, works for the one case it was written for — and loses everything… (microsoft)
- [Delete master and reference data with `Delete(true)` so the owning table's `OnDelete` decides](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/delete-master-data-with-trigger.md): Record.Delete() and Record.DeleteAll() do not run OnDelete unless RunTrigger is true; the default is false. (microsoft)
- [Design TableRelation branches for additive top-down extension](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/table-relation-extensions-are-additive-and-top-down.md): A tableextension can add to an existing TableRelation, but the combined relation is evaluated top-down after the original value. (microsoft)
- [Do not use SkipFieldsNotMatchingType to hide required TransferFields mismatches](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/transferfields-skip-type-mismatch-can-drop-data.md): Record.TransferFields copies values between fields with matching field numbers. (microsoft)
- [Enforce `Blocked` where the master is used, not in the master itself](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/check-blocked-in-referencing-code-not-in-master.md): The Blocked field on a master record (Item, Customer, Resource, or a custom master) is inert data. (microsoft)
- [Extend Find Entries (Navigate) for new document or transaction tables](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/extend-find-entries-navigate-for-new-document-types.md): page 344 Navigate (caption "Find entries") lets a user enter a document number and posting date and see, across every document and ledger entry table BC knows about, how many matching records exist — then drill into any of those rows. (microsoft)
- [Extend Price Source Type and its matching document subset enum together, with the same ID](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/extend-price-source-type-must-sync-document-subset-enum.md): enum 7003 "Price Source Type" (implements "Price Source", "Price Source Group") is the base list of who a price can apply to — Customer, Vendor, Customer Price Group, Campaign, and so on. (microsoft)
- [Generate report barcodes through the Barcode module, with the production font name](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/report-barcodes-must-use-barcode-module-and-production-font-name.md): Business Central's barcode support lives in the System Application's Barcode module (src/System Application/App/Barcode): interface "Barcode Font Provider" / "Barcode Font Provider 2D", enum "Barcode Symbology" / "Barcode Symbology 2D", and built-in implementations (codeunit 9215/9221). (microsoft)
- [Initialize document defaults in `InitRecord` after assigning the number](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/initialize-document-defaults-in-initrecord.md): Business Central document headers assign their number series first and then call an InitRecord procedure that owns the remaining business defaults, such as posting and document dates. (microsoft)
- [Mirrored TransferFields cascade fields must match type and length exactly](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/transferfields-mirrored-fields-must-match-type-and-length.md): Most custom fields genuinely belong to only one table — a status used only before posting, a note relevant only afterwards, whatever the case may be. (microsoft)
- [Never Change a Published Table's Primary or Clustered Key Field List](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/do-not-change-primary-key.md): Once a table has shipped — to AppSource, or to any customer environment that has already upgraded onto it — its primary key, and any other key marked Clustered = true, is frozen. (microsoft)
- [Pictures must be stored in a Media/MediaSet field, not BLOB](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/pictures-must-use-media-not-blob.md): BLOB is still a valid AL field type for arbitrary binary data, but it is not the right choice for storing pictures or images. (microsoft)
- [Refresh `Last Date Modified` in both `OnModify` and `OnRename`](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/set-last-date-modified-in-onmodify-and-onrename.md): Master tables carry a non-editable Last Date Modified field of type Date. (microsoft)
- [Register a new document type through Report Selections, and wire it into Document Layouts correctly](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/extend-report-selection-usage-for-new-document-types.md): A custom document that needs printing/emailing should be registered through table 77 "Report Selections". (microsoft)
- [Sales, purchase, and service line prices follow the header's Prices Including VAT](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/document-line-prices-follow-prices-including-vat.md): Line prices are gross or net depending on the header's Prices Including VAT. (microsoft)
- [Share MediaSet items with Insert instead of field assignment](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/share-mediaset-items-with-insert-not-field-assignment.md): Media and MediaSet fields store IDs that reference tenant media system tables. (microsoft)
- [Split posting routines into Check Line / Post Line / Post Batch](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/check-post-line-batch-pattern.md): Business Central's own journal-based posting routines consistently follow a three-codeunit split, each with one primary responsibility — Codeunit "Gen. (microsoft)
- [Tables must match one of Business Central's nine table-type conventions](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/table-design-must-match-bc-table-type-conventions.md): Business Central's Base Application follows nine recurring table types — Master, Supplemental, Subsidiary, Ledger, Register, Journal, Document, Document History, and Setup. (microsoft)
- [TestField a Setup-Table Value Before Using It in a Correctness-Critical Branch](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/testfield-required-setup-field.md): A procedure that reads a field from a setup or configuration table inside a branch where the surrounding logic has already decided that value is required needs to guard against it being blank. (microsoft)
- [Wire dimension support through DimensionManagement, not ad hoc fields](microsoft/knowledge/data-modeling/dimension-management-wiring.md): Adding dimension support to a custom table is not just a matter of adding a Code\[20\] field, and master tables and document/transactional tables wire into Codeunit "Dimension Management" through two different models — treating them as one mechanism is itself the mistake this article corrects: (microsoft)

## style

- [`APIVersion` must follow the pattern `vX.Y` (or `beta`)](microsoft/knowledge/style/api-page-version-format.md): The APIVersion property on an API page is part of the public URL path: /api/<publisher>/<group>/<version>/<entitySetName>. (microsoft)
- [`case` action goes on the line after the possibility](microsoft/knowledge/style/case-action-on-line-after-possibility.md): In an AL case statement, the action for each label is written on the line that follows the label, not on the same line. (microsoft)
- [`EntityName` is singular; `EntitySetName` is plural](microsoft/knowledge/style/api-page-entity-naming-singular-plural.md): EntityName and EntitySetName on an API page are the two halves of the OData naming contract. (microsoft)
- [A `var` parameter must be called with a variable, never a literal or expression](microsoft/knowledge/style/var-parameters-require-an-addressable-variable.md): When a procedure declares a parameter with var, that parameter is passed by reference: the callee writes back into the caller's own memory location. (microsoft)
- [A fixed set of named choices must use Enum, not a raw Integer](microsoft/knowledge/style/fixed-choice-set-must-use-enum-not-integer.md): When a variable or field represents a fixed set of named, mutually exclusive states — a difficulty level, a document type, a processing status — it should be typed as Enum (or Option when extending an object that still uses the legacy type). (microsoft)
- [A new procedure that changes the page's current record should take it as `var Record`](microsoft/knowledge/style/mutating-procedure-for-a-page-caller-takes-var-record.md): AL passes parameters by value unless they are declared var, and a by-value Record parameter is a copy: changes the procedure makes "affect only the copy, not the variable itself" (Working with AL methods). (microsoft)
- [A page or view name must describe the table it shows](microsoft/knowledge/style/page-name-must-match-source-table.md): A page (or filtered page View) whose name references one entity but whose SourceTable is a different entity misleads every consumer of the object's metadata. (microsoft)
- [Add XML documentation to public procedures on library/API codeunits](microsoft/knowledge/style/xmldoc-for-public-library-procedures.md): XML documentation comments (/// <summary>…</summary>, /// <param>…</param>, /// <returns>…</returns>) are expected on procedures that form the public surface of a library — codeunits intended to be called from outside the current app: System App modules, AppSource library codeunits, Access =… (microsoft)
- [API pages use camelCase, alphanumeric-only values for API properties](microsoft/knowledge/style/api-page-camelcase-properties.md): API pages — pages declared with PageType = API — surface as OData/JSON endpoints. (microsoft)
- [Binary yes/no choices must be typed as Boolean, not Option or Integer](microsoft/knowledge/style/binary-choice-must-be-boolean.md): When a field or variable represents a genuine true/false state — yes/no, on/off, active/inactive, blocked/not blocked — it should be typed Boolean. (microsoft)
- [Build links into the current environment's client with GetUrl, not a hand-written URL](microsoft/knowledge/style/build-client-links-with-geturl.md): This applies only to links that open a page, report, or record in the environment the code runs in. (microsoft)
- [Call objects by name, not by numeric ID](microsoft/knowledge/style/named-invocations-not-object-ids.md): Page.RunModal, Report.Run, Codeunit.Run, and the Page::, Report::, Codeunit::, Table::, XmlPort:: selectors accept either a numeric ID or a named alias. (microsoft)
- [Comments must not restate what the code already shows](microsoft/knowledge/style/al-comments-must-not-restate-what-code-already-shows.md): A comment above nearly every statement that just narrates what the statement already says (// Validate the customer number above SalesHeader.Validate("Sell-to Customer No.", CustomerNo)) adds noise without adding information. (microsoft)
- [Document each Label placeholder with the Comment parameter](microsoft/knowledge/style/label-comment-explains-placeholders.md): Label and TextConst strings that contain placeholders (%1, %2, …) need a Comment parameter that names what each placeholder is. (microsoft)
- [Intrinsic AL function calls use modern casing, not legacy ALL-CAPS](microsoft/knowledge/style/intrinsic-al-functions-must-use-modern-casing.md): AL is case-insensitive, so MESSAGE(...), ERROR(...), CONFIRM(...), and STRSUBSTNO(...) compile and run identically to Message(...), Error(...), Confirm(...), and StrSubstNo(...). (microsoft)
- [Keep business logic out of page objects](microsoft/knowledge/style/pages-must-not-contain-business-logic.md): A page procedure that persists a business mutation directly (Rec.Modify() outside the standard record-bound save, or a cross-entry-point business rule implemented only in a page trigger) is an architecture violation even when it compiles: the rule only applies when a user opens that specific page,… (microsoft)
- [Keep object names within the 30-character platform limit](microsoft/knowledge/style/object-name-30-char-limit.md): Business Central object names — for tables, pages, codeunits, reports, queries, XML ports, enums, and permission sets — are limited to 30 characters in total. (microsoft)
- [Name AL source files `<ObjectName>.<ObjectType>.al`](microsoft/knowledge/style/file-name-object-type-pattern.md): Each AL source file holds a single object, and the file name is expected to be of the form <ObjectName>.<ObjectType>.al — CustomerCard.Page.al, PostSalesInvoice.Codeunit.al, NoSeriesTests.Codeunit.al, SalesHeader.TableExt.al. (microsoft)
- [Omit `else` when the `then` branch ends with `exit`, `break`, `skip`, `quit`, or `error`](microsoft/knowledge/style/no-else-after-terminating-statement.md): When the then branch of an if ends in a terminating statement — exit, break, skip, quit, or error — the else branch becomes the natural fall-through. (microsoft)
- [Organize AL source by business feature, not object type](microsoft/knowledge/style/source-organized-by-feature-not-object-type.md): Folder structure inside an AL app has no effect on compilation or runtime behavior — this is a repository-organization convention, not a platform requirement, and different projects reasonably choose differently. (microsoft)
- [Page fields can inherit their source table field's `Caption`](microsoft/knowledge/style/caption-required-on-page-fields.md): A page field bound to a table field inherits the source field's Caption unless the page overrides it. (microsoft)
- [Page fields need an explicit or inherited `ToolTip` (CodeCop AA0218)](microsoft/knowledge/style/tooltip-required-on-page-fields.md): User-facing page fields need tooltip text, but it does not have to be declared on each page control. (microsoft)
- [Parse DateFormula constants with language-independent input](microsoft/knowledge/style/dateformula-evaluate-needs-language-independent-literals.md): A DateFormula stores a formula in a language-independent representation, but Evaluate must first interpret its text input. (microsoft)
- [Pass parameters directly to `Error()`, do not wrap with `StrSubstNo`](microsoft/knowledge/style/error-passes-parameters-directly-not-strsubstno.md): Error() accepts a format string and a variable number of arguments — Error(SomeLabelErr, Arg1, Arg2). (microsoft)
- [Prefix temporary record variables with `Temp`](microsoft/knowledge/style/temporary-variable-temp-prefix.md): A Record variable declared with the temporary modifier behaves nothing like a normal record variable: it never touches the database, holds rows only for the lifetime of the variable, and is not visible to filters or queries on the underlying table. (microsoft)
- [Procedure-local Labels are valid](microsoft/knowledge/style/labels-declared-at-object-scope.md): The AL language supports Label variables at both object and procedure scope. (microsoft)
- [Resolve a namespace from the referenced object's source or symbols, never by guessing](microsoft/knowledge/style/namespace-must-be-verified-from-source.md): Since Business Central 2024 release wave 1, Microsoft's own objects are organized under a deep Microsoft.* namespace tree that has been renamed and restructured repeatedly. (microsoft)
- [Set `DelayedInsert = true` on API pages](microsoft/knowledge/style/api-page-delayedinsert-true.md): On a normal page, DelayedInsert = false is the default: the record is inserted into the table as soon as the user enters the first field, and subsequent fields are written via Modify triggers. (microsoft)
- [Set `Locked = true` on Labels that must not be translated](microsoft/knowledge/style/label-locked-for-non-translatable.md): A Label is by default surfaced to translators and rewritten per locale. (microsoft)
- [Use `AboutTitle` and `AboutText` to surface teaching tips on top-level pages](microsoft/knowledge/style/abouttitle-abouttext-teaching-tips.md): The AboutTitle and AboutText properties on a page render a teaching tip — an onboarding callout that appears the first time a user opens the page. (microsoft)
- [Use FieldCaption/TableCaption (not FieldName/TableName) in user-facing text](microsoft/knowledge/style/fieldcaption-not-fieldname-in-user-messages.md): FieldName and TableName return the developer-facing identifier of a field or table — a fixed English string used in metadata and in code. (microsoft)
- [Write AL Build Artifacts to an Intentional Output Location](microsoft/knowledge/style/al-build-output-must-not-pollute-project-root.md): An AL project's compiled .app file can be written to the project root by default, and current tooling explicitly supports choosing a different destination instead — ALTool's --outfolder option and the al_build agent tool's outputPath parameter both exist for this. (microsoft)
- [Write AL Identifiers in English Only](microsoft/knowledge/style/al-identifiers-english.md): All AL identifiers — variables, procedures, parameters, fields, object names, enum values, and label identifiers — must be written in English, regardless of the developer's native language. (microsoft)

## security

- [A secret belongs in IsolatedStorage, never in a table field](microsoft/knowledge/security/secrets-isolated-storage.md): API keys, OAuth tokens, client secrets, and connection strings must not be stored in an ordinary table Text field — not even on a hidden setup table. (microsoft)
- [Access Internal is API hygiene, not an authorization boundary](microsoft/knowledge/security/internal-access-is-not-a-security-boundary.md): Access = Internal controls compile-time symbol visibility. (microsoft)
- [AL has no built-in HtmlEncode — encode HTML output by hand or avoid it](microsoft/knowledge/security/al-has-no-built-in-htmlencode.md): AL does not ship a built-in HtmlEncode (or equivalent) function. (microsoft)
- [Avoid wildcard grants in permission sets](microsoft/knowledge/security/permission-set-avoid-wildcard-grants.md): A permissionset object can grant access object-by-object or with the * wildcard. (microsoft)
- [Compose permission sets with IncludedPermissionSets](microsoft/knowledge/security/compose-permission-sets-with-included-sets.md): The IncludedPermissionSets property lets one AL permission set reference another, composing rights out of smaller building blocks. (microsoft)
- [Do not concatenate external text into a SetFilter expression](microsoft/knowledge/security/do-not-concatenate-external-text-into-setfilter.md): The String argument of SetFilter is a filter expression, not a value. (microsoft)
- [Do not expose security guards as `var` parameters on IntegrationEvent](microsoft/knowledge/security/integrationevent-var-parameter-bypasses-security-guards.md): A var parameter on an \[IntegrationEvent\] is a mutable hook: any subscriber can overwrite the value and the publisher will see the new value when control returns. (microsoft)
- [Do not grant rights beyond a user's entitlement](microsoft/knowledge/security/do-not-grant-rights-beyond-a-users-entitlement.md): Entitlements are license-level caps on what a user can access, derived automatically from the BC license tier. (microsoft)
- [Do not pass credentials or secrets through IntegrationEvent parameters](microsoft/knowledge/security/integrationevent-must-not-expose-secrets.md): \[IntegrationEvent\] publishes a hook that any extension can subscribe to. (microsoft)
- [Every exposed object must belong to a permission set](microsoft/knowledge/security/exposed-objects-must-be-in-a-permission-set.md): An object that is reachable from outside the app's own UI is only usable if it is also granted execute access through a permission set. (microsoft)
- [Filters that restrict what a page shows must not be set in filter group 0](microsoft/knowledge/security/page-scope-filters-must-not-be-in-filtergroup-zero.md): Filter group 0 is the standard group: it holds the filters the user sees and edits in the filter pane. (microsoft)
- [Grant the minimum InherentPermissions a procedure needs](microsoft/knowledge/security/inherent-permissions-minimal-grant.md): \[InherentPermissions(PermissionObjectType::..., ...)\] and \[InherentEntitlements(Entitlement::...)\] are method-level attributes that let a procedure perform an operation on the listed object even when the caller's permission set does not allow it. (microsoft)
- [Guard bulk operations with IsTemporary](microsoft/knowledge/security/guard-bulk-operations-with-istemporary.md): An AL helper that accepts a var Rec: Record X parameter and performs a bulk operation (DeleteAll, ModifyAll, or an unfiltered loop that mutates every record) cannot tell from the signature alone whether the caller passed a temporary buffer or the real table. (microsoft)
- [Handle free-form input when ValidateTableRelation is false](microsoft/knowledge/security/validatetablerelation-false-on-user-input.md): ValidateTableRelation = false intentionally lets a user keep free-form input even when it does not match TableRelation. (microsoft)
- [On-premises only: protect unavoidable SecretText.Unwrap calls](microsoft/knowledge/security/nondebuggable-required-when-unwrapping-secrettext.md): SecretText.Unwrap() is supported only for Business Central on-premises and exists for compatibility. (microsoft)
- [Pick the right IsolatedStorage DataScope for the secret's lifetime](microsoft/knowledge/security/isolatedstorage-datascope-module-vs-company.md): IsolatedStorage read and write methods take a DataScope parameter that decides which slice of storage the value belongs to. (microsoft)
- [Prefer IsolatedStorage.SetEncrypted over Set for sensitive values](microsoft/knowledge/security/isolatedstorage-setencrypted-for-sensitive-values.md): IsolatedStorage exposes two write entry points: Set stores the value as-is, and SetEncrypted stores it encrypted at rest. (microsoft)
- [Prefer OAuth2 over API keys for external HTTP calls](microsoft/knowledge/security/prefer-oauth2-over-api-keys-for-external-http-calls.md): External HTTP integrations from AL can authenticate using OAuth 2.0 (client-credentials for service-to-service, authorization-code for user-delegated), API keys, basic authentication, or credentials in URLs. (microsoft)
- [Procedures that read or write IsolatedStorage must not be public](microsoft/knowledge/security/isolatedstorage-access-must-be-local-or-internal.md): IsolatedStorage partitions its data by extension: values written by one extension are unreadable to another. (microsoft)
- [Procedures that RecordRef.Open a caller-provided table must not be public](microsoft/knowledge/security/recordref-open-with-caller-table-must-not-be-public.md): When a codeunit holds permission to system tables — directly, via a permission set granted at install, or via \[InherentPermissions\] — and exposes a public procedure that accepts a table number (or a RecordId, from which the table number is derived) and calls RecordRef.Open on it, the procedure… (microsoft)
- [Protect sensitive data in temporary tables](microsoft/knowledge/security/protect-sensitive-data-in-temporary-tables.md): A temporary record copies data out of the source table into session memory. (microsoft)
- [Restore the filter group after setting hidden filters, and do not reuse platform groups](microsoft/knowledge/security/restore-the-filtergroup-after-setting-hidden-filters.md): FilterGroup(N) changes the current group for every later SetRange/SetFilter on that record variable until it is changed again. (microsoft)
- [Set secret request URIs on HttpRequestMessage](microsoft/knowledge/security/secrettext-with-httpclient.md): The secret URI API belongs to HttpRequestMessage, not HttpClient. (microsoft)
- [Storing GetLastErrorText() in table fields is a privacy finding, not a security finding](microsoft/knowledge/security/getlasterrortext-storage-is-privacy-not-security.md): It is tempting to flag any code that calls GetLastErrorText() and writes the result into a table field (or displays it to end users) as a security issue, on the assumption that the error text might leak credentials or system internals. (microsoft)
- [Use \[CommitBehavior\] to protect an atomic operation from third-party commits](microsoft/knowledge/security/commitbehavior-attribute-scopes-explicit-commits.md): \[CommitBehavior(CommitBehavior::Ignore)\] and \[CommitBehavior(CommitBehavior::Error)\] are method-level attributes that restrict what an explicit Commit() does inside the annotated method's scope: Ignore silently discards the call; Error raises a runtime error. (microsoft)
- [Use indirect permissions when access must be code-mediated](microsoft/knowledge/security/indirect-permissions-for-elevated-access.md): In a permissionset, uppercase letters (R, I, M, D) grant direct permissions: the assignee can read, insert, modify, or delete the table data through any UI or API surface. (microsoft)
- [Use SecretStrSubstNo to compose strings that contain secrets](microsoft/knowledge/security/secretstrsubstno-for-composing-secrets.md): SecretStrSubstNo is the secret-preserving counterpart of StrSubstNo. (microsoft)
- [Use SecretText for credentials, API keys, and tokens](microsoft/knowledge/security/secrettext-for-credentials.md): SecretText is the AL data type for values that should never appear in a debugger session, in a log, or in a variable watch. (microsoft)
- [Validate responses from unauthenticated endpoints before trusting them](microsoft/knowledge/security/validate-unauthenticated-response-before-use.md): When AL calls an external endpoint that does not authenticate *itself* to the client, the response is fully attacker-influenceable — cleartext MITM, a spoofed or compromised host, DNS/redirect games, or simply a misbehaving public service. (microsoft)
- [Validate URLs that come from table fields before calling them](microsoft/knowledge/security/validate-user-configurable-urls.md): A URL stored in a table field is user-configurable: anyone with write access to the row can change it. (microsoft)

## upgrade

- [`DataTransfer` does not fire validation triggers or event subscribers](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/datatransfer-skips-triggers-and-subscribers.md): DataTransfer writes sets directly at the database layer, so row-based triggers and events do not run. (microsoft)
- [`InitValue` does not back-fill existing rows](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/initvalue-does-not-update-existing-rows.md): InitValue on a field defines the value the platform assigns when a *new* record is inserted. (microsoft)
- [`ModuleInfo.AppVersion` changes meaning with execution context](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/appversion-meaning-depends-on-execution-context.md): ModuleInfo.AppVersion() is the installed version during normal operation, the version being installed inside install code, and the target version inside upgrade code. (microsoft)
- [`OnUpgradePerCompany` / `OnUpgradePerDatabase` should call helpers, not inline logic](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/triggers-call-helpers-not-implementations.md): The OnUpgradePerCompany and OnUpgradePerDatabase triggers on an upgrade codeunit are dispatch points, not implementation slots. (microsoft)
- [Add new enum values only at the end](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/enum-values-additive-at-end.md): An AL enum is a fixed list of ordinal-named values. (microsoft)
- [Control upgrade execution with upgrade tags, not version checks](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/use-upgrade-tags-not-version-checks.md): Each piece of upgrade logic must run exactly once per company (or database) across the lifetime of an extension. (microsoft)
- [Detect first install with `DataVersion() = Version.Create('0.0.0.0')`](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/first-install-dataversion-zero-check.md): On the first install of an extension on a tenant the platform records a zero data version: AppInfo.DataVersion() returns Version.Create('0.0.0.0'). (microsoft)
- [Give every obsolete element a reason and tag](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/obsoletion-requires-reason-and-tag.md): AL has two obsoletion mechanisms, depending on the symbol: (microsoft)
- [Guard every database read in upgrade code with `if`](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/guard-database-reads.md): Inside an upgrade codeunit (or any procedure transitively invoked from OnUpgradePerCompany / OnUpgradePerDatabase), an unguarded Record.Get, Record.FindSet, or Record.FindLast raises a runtime error when the row or set is missing. (microsoft)
- [Hybrid migration codeunits are not standard upgrade codeunits](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/hybrid-migration-codeunits-not-standard-upgrade.md): Codeunits like HybridBC14, HybridSL, HybridGP, and HybridBaseDeployment implement one-time migration paths from a specific source system into Business Central. (microsoft)
- [Install code does not run during a version upgrade](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/install-code-does-not-run-on-version-upgrade.md): An install codeunit runs when an extension is installed for the first time or an uninstalled version is installed again. (microsoft)
- [Keep upgrade validation checks bounded](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/minimize-onvalidate-upgrade-triggers.md): Triggers such as OnValidateUpgradePerCompany run on every upgrade pass. (microsoft)
- [Log telemetry; do not raise errors that block the upgrade](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/do-not-block-upgrade-on-data-errors.md): When upgrade code encounters unexpected data — a record it expected to find, a relationship it assumed to be intact — the response is to log telemetry and continue, not to raise an error. (microsoft)
- [Never nest upgrade tag checks or blend two migrations under one tag](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/upgrade-tag-logic-must-not-nest-deeply.md): Upgrade tag *checks* should stay flat: never nest one tag's existence check inside another tag's guarded body, and never let one tagged procedure quietly perform a second, functionally distinct migration — that turns two upgrade steps into one that can't be tracked, skipped, or fixed… (microsoft)
- [No external calls inside upgrade codeunits](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/no-external-calls-in-upgrade.md): Upgrade code runs in a constrained execution window: the tenant is mid-upgrade, no users are signed in, and a failure aborts the entire transaction. (microsoft)
- [ObsoleteReason need not restate the removal version; ObsoleteTag carries it](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/obsoletereason-need-not-restate-removal-version.md): An obsoleted object, field, key, enum, or enum value carries both ObsoleteReason and ObsoleteTag, and the two properties have different jobs. (microsoft)
- [Primary-key and field-type changes are safe only on tables without existing data](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/breaking-changes-only-on-tables-without-data.md): Primary-key changes and field-type changes (for example widening Integer to BigInteger) rewrite the on-disk layout of every row in the table. (microsoft)
- [Register upgrade tags that must be seeded for new companies](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/register-upgrade-tags-with-subscribers.md): SetUpgradeTag(Tag) directly records a completed per-company upgrade step; HasUpgradeTag(Tag) can then guard that step on later upgrades. (microsoft)
- [Separate install or upgrade codeunits have no execution order](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/install-and-upgrade-codeunits-have-no-order.md): An extension can contain multiple Install or Upgrade codeunits, but Business Central does not guarantee the order in which codeunits of the same subtype execute. (microsoft)
- [Skip non-essential runtime work when `GetExecutionContext() = ExecutionContext::Upgrade`](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/skip-nonessential-work-via-execution-context.md): Runtime procedures (table triggers, install routines, helpers called from many places) sometimes fire during the upgrade window because the upgrade itself touches the data they react to. (microsoft)
- [Stage obsoletion `Pending → Removed`; write upgrade code on removal](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/obsolete-pending-to-removed-staging.md): ObsoleteState has a deliberate two-step lifecycle. (microsoft)
- [Unreleased schema changes need no upgrade or migration path](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/unreleased-schema-change-needs-no-upgrade-path.md): Upgrade and migration findings protect data and schema that have already shipped to customers. (microsoft)
- [Upgrade check triggers do not migrate data](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/check-only-triggers-do-not-migrate-data.md): OnCheckPreconditionsPerCompany/PerDatabase run before the upgrade to verify that it can start. (microsoft)
- [Upgrade code must not use ChangeCompany](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/no-changecompany-in-upgrade.md): The platform upgrades each company in its own context: OnUpgradePerCompany (like the other PerCompany upgrade and install triggers) runs once per company, in a separate system session opened for that company, while PerDatabase triggers run in a session that opens no company. (microsoft)
- [Upgrade logic must live in a codeunit with `Subtype = Upgrade`](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/upgrade-codeunit-subtype.md): A codeunit only participates in the upgrade pipeline when it sets Subtype = Upgrade. (microsoft)
- [Use `DataTransfer` for bulk updates on large tables](microsoft/knowledge/upgrade/datatransfer-for-bulk-init.md): Tables that can contain more than 300,000 records, and any newly added field on an existing table, should be initialized with DataTransfer rather than a repeat ... (microsoft)

## events

- [Adding a parameter to an event is not a breaking change](microsoft/knowledge/events/adding-a-parameter-to-an-event-is-not-a-breaking-change.md): Adding a parameter to an existing event publisher does not break existing subscribers. (microsoft)
- [An isolated event's rollback does not undo var parameters or other in-memory state](microsoft/knowledge/events/isolated-event-rollback-does-not-undo-var-parameters.md): When a subscriber to an isolated event fails, the platform rolls back only the Insert, Modify, and Delete calls it made on normal tables. (microsoft)
- [Avoid loosely typed event parameters](microsoft/knowledge/events/avoid-loosely-typed-event-parameters.md): Passing RecordRef or xRec as event parameters weakens the contract. (microsoft)
- [ChangeCompany leaves triggers and trigger-event subscribers running in the calling company](microsoft/knowledge/events/changecompany-runs-triggers-in-the-calling-company.md): ChangeCompany redirects the data access of one record variable to another company's table. (microsoft)
- [Choose static vs manual subscribers deliberately and bind manual ones with BindSubscription](microsoft/knowledge/events/choose-static-vs-manual-subscribers-deliberately.md): An \[EventSubscriber\] codeunit is static by default (EventSubscriberInstance = StaticAutomatic): it is always bound, so it fires for every raise of the event in every session. (microsoft)
- [Database trigger setup flags may only be set to true](microsoft/knowledge/events/database-trigger-setup-flags-may-only-be-set-to-true.md): The OnDatabaseInsert, OnDatabaseModify, OnDatabaseDelete, and OnDatabaseRename events let one subscriber react to writes on any table, receiving the record as a RecordRef. (microsoft)
- [Declare event publishers local or internal](microsoft/knowledge/events/declare-event-publishers-local-or-internal.md): The access modifier on an \[IntegrationEvent\] or \[BusinessEvent\] publisher controls who may *raise* the procedure, not who may *subscribe* to it. (microsoft)
- [Do not add IsHandled to an existing event](microsoft/knowledge/events/do-not-add-ishandled-to-an-existing-event.md): Adding a var IsHandled: Boolean parameter to an event that already shipped without one silently changes the event's purpose — from a plain notification into an overridable seam. (microsoft)
- [Do not bypass critical operations with IsHandled](microsoft/knowledge/events/do-not-bypass-critical-operations-with-ishandled.md): The IsHandled override pattern lets a subscriber skip the guarded code entirely. (microsoft)
- [Do not change shipped event attribute flags](microsoft/knowledge/events/do-not-change-shipped-event-attribute-flags.md): IncludeSender and, on Integration events, GlobalVarAccess have been event-contract flags since runtime 1.0. (microsoft)
- [Do not publish events inside loops](microsoft/knowledge/events/do-not-publish-events-inside-loops.md): Raising an event on every iteration of a loop multiplies the cost of every subscriber by the number of records. (microsoft)
- [Do not raise integration events inside a TryFunction](microsoft/knowledge/events/avoid-raising-events-inside-try-functions.md): A TryFunction catches all errors — including errors thrown by event subscribers. (microsoft)
- [Event parameter additions depend on publisher access, not position](microsoft/knowledge/events/add-new-event-parameters-at-the-end.md): Event subscribers bind publisher parameters by name and can omit parameters they do not use. (microsoft)
- [Expose process context through a manually bound flag, not a single-instance boolean](microsoft/knowledge/events/expose-process-context-via-manually-bound-flag.md): When an extension drives a process over shared code — a base application report, a posting routine — other extensions hooked into that code cannot tell whether a run belongs to that process: AL keeps no ambient "current process", so the driving app has to publish the context itself. (microsoft)
- [Isolated events are isolated only when no write transaction is open](microsoft/knowledge/events/isolated-events-are-isolated-only-outside-a-write-transaction.md): Setting Isolated = true on a BusinessEvent, IntegrationEvent, or InternalEvent (runtime 9.0 / BC20 and later) runs each subscriber in its own transaction: a failing subscriber is rolled back and the next subscriber, then the caller, continue. (microsoft)
- [Name event parameters without abbreviations](microsoft/knowledge/events/name-event-parameters-without-abbreviations.md): Event parameter names are part of the public contract a subscriber codes against, so they must be self-explanatory. (microsoft)
- [Name events by publisher position](microsoft/knowledge/events/name-events-by-publisher-position.md): An event name should tell a subscriber where in the publisher the event fires. (microsoft)
- [Prefer reusing or extending existing events](microsoft/knowledge/events/prefer-reusing-or-extending-existing-events.md): Before adding a publisher, check whether an event already fires at that point in the code. (microsoft)
- [Prefer this over IncludeSender in new codeunit events](microsoft/knowledge/events/prefer-this-over-includesender-in-codeunit-events.md): When designing a new publisher, setting IncludeSender to true on \[IntegrationEvent\] or \[BusinessEvent\] gives subscribers the publishing object as an implicit sender parameter. (microsoft)
- [Prefix temporary record event parameters with Temp](microsoft/knowledge/events/prefix-temporary-record-event-parameters-with-temp.md): When a record passed to an event is a temporary record — an in-memory buffer not persisted to the database — its parameter name must start with Temp. (microsoft)
- [Preserve OnAfter execution when IsHandled skips the body](microsoft/knowledge/events/preserve-onafter-execution-when-ishandled-skips-the-body.md): A routine that exposes both an OnBefore… event (with var IsHandled) and a paired OnAfter… event has a subtle trap. (microsoft)
- [Publish thin OnBefore/OnAfter integration events to expose extension points](microsoft/knowledge/events/publish-thin-onbefore-onafter-integration-events.md): A key operation — a posting, release, or validation routine — becomes a hard wall for partners when it ships no integration events: the only way to change it is to overwrite or duplicate the base code. (microsoft)
- [Reset IsHandled before publishing only when its value can carry over](microsoft/knowledge/events/reset-ishandled-only-when-the-value-can-carry-over.md): A routine that raises an OnBefore… integration event with a var IsHandled: Boolean parameter passes that variable by reference, so a pre-existing true can affect the following control flow. (microsoft)
- [Treat local and internal events as subscriber contracts](microsoft/knowledge/events/treat-local-and-internal-events-as-subscriber-contracts.md): The local and internal access modifiers on Business and Integration event publishers restrict who can raise the procedure; they do not prevent dependent extensions from subscribing. (microsoft)
