- [Use the IsHandled pattern to make base behaviour overridable](microsoft/knowledge/events/use-ishandled-to-make-base-behaviour-overridable.md): AL has no method overriding, so a procedure that runs its body unconditionally cannot be replaced by an extension without editing base code. (microsoft)

## agents

- [Agent permissions intersect the assigner's; agents cannot configure users](community/knowledge/agents/agent-permissions-intersect-with-assigner.md): An agent is a user, but it cannot configure users or other agents, and it cannot open sensitive pages such as user cards or permission-set assignment. (community)
- [Agent setup pages use ConfigurationDialog and the Agent Setup Part](community/knowledge/agents/agent-setup-page-is-configuration-dialog.md): Instance setup is not a Card or StandardDialog. (community)
- [Agent setup tables are keyed by User Security ID](community/knowledge/agents/agent-setup-table-keyed-by-user-security-id.md): Each agent instance is a user. (community)
- [AnalyzeAgentTaskMessage: Error stops the task; Warning still requires review](community/knowledge/agents/analyze-message-error-stops-warning-forces-review.md): IAgentTaskExecution.AnalyzeAgentTaskMessage runs on inbound and outbound messages. (community)
- [Bind extra agent subscribers only inside an agent session](community/knowledge/agents/bind-agent-subscribers-only-in-agent-session.md): Page-filter tweaks, extra validation, and prompt dialogs for the agent should not run for every user. (community)
- [Default agent permission sets must exist in AL and stay least privilege](community/knowledge/agents/get-default-access-controls-least-privilege.md): IAgentFactory.GetDefaultAccessControls fills a temporary Access Control Buffer used when an instance is created. (community)
- [Do not create agent instances from install, upgrade, or background sessions](community/knowledge/agents/do-not-create-agents-in-install-upgrade-or-background.md): Agent.Create requires an interactive user session. (community)
- [Give the agent a dedicated profile that hides unrelated UI](community/knowledge/agents/agent-profile-narrows-visible-ui.md): The agent only sees what its profile shows. (community)
- [Instruction documents use responsibilities, guidelines, then ordered steps](community/knowledge/agents/instruction-structure-is-role-rules-steps.md): The runtime treats instructions as the agent's standing prompt. (community)
- [Instructions describe outcomes, not page action or tool names](community/knowledge/agents/instructions-describe-work-not-tool-ids.md): Agent tools are the UI the profile exposes. (community)
- [Keep the agent setup page source temporary until Update](community/knowledge/agents/agent-setup-source-table-is-temporary.md): ConfigurationDialog setup is a draft: the user can Cancel without writing. (community)
- [Other apps cannot call the toolkit APIs on your agent; publish your own API](community/knowledge/agents/cross-app-agent-calls-need-your-public-api.md): For isolation, Agent, Agent Task Builder, and related toolkit codeunits error when the target instance belongs to another app. (community)
- [Reapply resource instructions to existing agent instances on upgrade](community/knowledge/agents/reapply-resource-instructions-on-upgrade.md): Static instructions stored as an app resource are copied onto an instance only when you call SetInstructions. (community)
- [Register a Copilot capability for the agent on install](community/knowledge/agents/register-copilot-capability-for-the-agent.md): Each agent type needs a Copilot Capability enum value that the factory links as the feature switch and billing surface. (community)
- [Set agent instructions as SecretText on the instance](community/knowledge/agents/set-instructions-as-secrettext.md): Instructions are instance data, not an enum caption. (community)
- [ShowCanCreateAgent only hides UI create, not programmatic create](community/knowledge/agents/show-can-create-agent-does-not-block-code-create.md): IAgentFactory.ShowCanCreateAgent controls whether the type appears in the in-client create UI. (community)
- [Skip incoming message review only after the caller validated the payload](community/knowledge/agents/skip-incoming-review-only-for-trusted-input.md): Incoming task messages default to requiring user approval before the agent runs. (community)
- [The default agent profile must be an AL profile in the app](community/knowledge/agents/get-default-profile-lives-in-the-app.md): IAgentFactory.GetDefaultProfile assigns the Role Center and page customizations the agent UI-navigates. (community)
- [Use the toolkit instruction keywords for review, mail, and memory](community/knowledge/agents/use-documented-instruction-keywords.md): The agent runtime looks for specific phrases: ask for assistance, request a review, reply, write an email, memorize, Set field, use lookup, Invoke action. (community)
- [Wire all three agent interfaces on the metadata provider](community/knowledge/agents/wire-all-three-agent-interfaces.md): An AL agent type is registered by extending Agent Metadata Provider. (community)

## privacy

- [`FeatureTelemetry` `CustomDimensions` follow the same privacy rules as `Session.LogMessage`](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/featuretelemetry-customdimensions-no-pii.md): Codeunit "Feature Telemetry" is the second telemetry surface in AL. (microsoft)
- [Check the custom Privacy Notice before external data transfer](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/privacy-notice-consent-for-external-data-transfer.md): Business Central's Codeunit "Privacy Notice" creates notices and records per-integration approval. (microsoft)
- [DataClassification is a table-field property, not a page-field property](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/data-classification-is-table-field-property.md): DataClassification is defined on table fields. (microsoft)
- [DataClassification is required on table fields containing sensitive data](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/data-classification-required-on-pii-fields.md): DataClassification tells the platform what kind of data a table field stores so that telemetry, GDPR data-subject requests, and the platform's audit surfaces can treat it correctly. (microsoft)
- [Displaying fields on a page (or in a UI dialog) is not a privacy concern](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/page-display-is-not-a-privacy-concern.md): Every page in Business Central — Card, List, API, ListPart, request pages — renders data to an authenticated user who has been granted permission to see it. (microsoft)
- [Do not embed customer data in the telemetry message text](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/no-pii-in-telemetry-message-string.md): Session.LogMessage's message argument is a plain Text. (microsoft)
- [Error dialogs emit Error method trace telemetry](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/error-vs-message-telemetry-logging.md): When Error displays a dialog, Business Central emits the RT0030 Error method trace telemetry signal. (microsoft)
- [Every `Session.LogMessage` call must specify `DataClassification`](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/session-logmessage-requires-dataclassification.md): Session.LogMessage writes a record to the telemetry pipeline. (microsoft)
- [Extension-owned log tables must be registered as retention-policy allowed tables](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/register-owned-log-tables-for-retention-policies.md): The retention policy engine only ever deletes from tables that appear in its allowed-tables list, and an extension may register only tables it owns — it cannot add a base application table or a table from another extension. (microsoft)
- [FeatureTelemetry.LogError emits more than caller custom dimensions](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/featuretelemetry-logerror-implicit-errortext.md): FeatureTelemetry.LogError emits its ErrorText as the telemetry message and adds it as alErrorText. (microsoft)
- [FlowFields and FlowFilters are classified `SystemMetadata` automatically](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/flowfield-flowfilter-classification-systemmetadata.md): FlowField and FlowFilter are not stored fields — a FlowField is computed from a CalcFormula at read time and a FlowFilter is a transient filter scoped to the record variable. (microsoft)
- [In data migration code, classify the destination — not the migration itself](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/migration-destination-classification.md): Migration codeunits such as HybridSL, HybridGP, and HybridBC exist to copy sensitive data — TINs, Federal IDs, social security numbers, financial records — from a source system into Business Central. (microsoft)
- [In-memory variables, dictionaries, lists and temporary tables are not a privacy concern](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/in-memory-data-not-a-privacy-concern.md): AL runs in a managed server environment. (microsoft)
- [Pass a Label directly as the first Error argument](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/avoid-strsubstno-prebuild-before-error.md): Error method trace telemetry includes the AL error string only when the first Error argument is a Label or TextConst. (microsoft)
- [Register custom integrations with Codeunit Privacy Notice](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/register-integration-in-privacy-notice-registrations.md): The current extension point is Codeunit "Privacy Notice". (microsoft)
- [Registering a table does not delete anything — consider shipping a default setup](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/ship-a-default-retention-policy-setup.md): AddAllowedTable only makes a table selectable on the Retention Policies page. (microsoft)
- [Resolve every `ToBeClassified` before release](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/resolve-tobeclassified-before-release.md): DataClassification = ToBeClassified is the sentinel value the AL compiler accepts while a developer has not yet decided what a new field actually stores. (microsoft)
- [Review each ErrorInfo text surface by its actual exposure](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/errorinfo-telemetry-classification-and-errortype.md): Runtime 3.0 (BC 14) provides ErrorInfo.Message, DataClassification, and ErrorType. (microsoft)
- [Table-level DataClassification is inherited by fields](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/table-level-data-classification-cascades.md): A valid table-level DataClassification is the effective default for the Normal fields declared inside that table object when they do not declare their own value, and AppSourceCop AS0016 accepts those fields rather than reporting them as unclassified. (microsoft)
- [Treat `GetLastErrorText()` as potential customer content](microsoft/knowledge/privacy/getlasterrortext-customer-content-in-errors.md): Parameterless GetLastErrorText() can contain customer content such as field values, record keys, and file names. (microsoft)

## testing

- [Build fixtures with the test Library codeunits, not hand-rolled Init/Insert](microsoft/knowledge/testing/use-library-codeunits-for-test-fixtures.md): BC ships a layer of test Library codeunits — LibrarySales, LibraryPurchase, LibraryERM, LibraryInventory, LibraryRandom and many more — whose job is to create valid records. (microsoft)
- [Commit shared fixture data created inside a lazy Initialize(), or later tests lose it](microsoft/knowledge/testing/commit-shared-test-fixture-inside-lazy-initialize.md): A test method with no \[TransactionModel(...)\] attribute defaults to AutoCommit (see transactionmodel-attribute-governs-test-transactions.md): a method that completes without error commits automatically at its own boundary, with no explicit Commit() needed. (microsoft)
- [Configure TestIsolation on the test runner](microsoft/knowledge/testing/testisolation-belongs-on-the-test-runner.md): TestIsolation is a property of a Subtype = TestRunner codeunit, not of the test codeunit being executed. (microsoft)
- [Cover the full precondition chain in GIVEN, not just the primary record](microsoft/knowledge/testing/given-blocks-must-cover-full-precondition-chain.md): A \[GIVEN\] block is only correct if it sets up every precondition the code under test actually reads, not just the record the scenario is "about." For most master-data tests, creating the primary record is enough. (microsoft)
- [Exclude a known-valid TableRelation exception via OnAfterRemoveTableRelation](microsoft/knowledge/testing/table-relation-test-exclude-known-invalid-relations-via-event.md): Codeunit 134926 "Table Relation Test" (shipped in BCApps' test app — only consumers that depend on the BC test libraries can subscribe to it) reads Table Relations Metadata tenant-wide across every installed app, not just the current one, and validates each field's type and length against what its… (microsoft)
- [Generate Test Data Programmatically, Never Assume Existing Records](microsoft/knowledge/testing/test-data-must-be-random-and-complete.md): A BC test company normally contains initialized system/setup data — an AL test suite should not assume an empty database, but it must be independent of unrelated business records: create the records and setup it owns rather than looking up a specific code, number, or name assumed to already exist,… (microsoft)
- [Generate unique test fixture values with LibraryUtility helpers, not hardcoded literals](microsoft/knowledge/testing/use-generateguid-for-unique-test-fixture-values.md): A fixture helper that assigns a hardcoded literal to a primary-key field, or to any field the test relies on as a unique lookup identifier, collides the moment two tests, or two runs of the same test, create that fixture without cleanup — and a literal longer than the field allows raises a… (microsoft)
- [Include app-specific scenarios in a PerformanceTest app's BCPT suite](microsoft/knowledge/testing/bcpt-scenarios-must-be-app-specific.md): A PerformanceTest app that ships with only the generic Microsoft BCPT samples (creating sales orders, purchase orders, posting item journals) measures Business Central's own baseline performance, not the extension it was built to test. (microsoft)
- [Keep exactly one WHEN per test, with narrow exceptions for flow and defect-then-fix tests](microsoft/knowledge/testing/test-one-when-per-test.md): This is a testing-design practice, not a BC platform requirement — no AL API enforces it, and it should not gate a change the way a platform-contradicted claim would. (microsoft)
- [Match TransactionModel to the commit behavior of the code under test](microsoft/knowledge/testing/transactionmodel-attribute-governs-test-transactions.md): \[TransactionModel(...)\] declares how a test method interacts with the database's write transaction. (microsoft)
- [Permission tests must actually lower the execution context](microsoft/knowledge/testing/permission-tests-must-lower-the-execution-context.md): TestPermissions describes how a test runner should establish the permission context; the enum value does not itself assign the business permission set being tested. (microsoft)
- [Pin asserterror to a specific error with ExpectedError and ExpectedErrorCode](microsoft/knowledge/testing/asserterror-needs-expectederror-and-code.md): asserterror passes when the guarded statement raises any error at all. (microsoft)
- [RecordRef.Open with Temp = true cannot check the real table](microsoft/knowledge/testing/recordref-open-temp-parameter-defeats-real-table-checks.md): RecordRef.Open(No: Integer \[, Temp: Boolean\] \[, CompanyName: Text\]) always takes a real table number. (microsoft)
- [Reset per-test state before the IsInitialized guard](microsoft/knowledge/testing/reset-per-test-state-before-the-isinitialized-guard.md): Standard Business Central test codeunits call a local Initialize procedure at the start of every test method. (microsoft)
- [Separate UI-layer and logic-layer tests into different codeunits](microsoft/knowledge/testing/ui-test-codeunit-naming.md): A test codeunit that drives pages through TestPage — opening pages, reading FactBox parts, triggering field OnValidate through the page — is testing a different layer than a codeunit that calls business-logic procedures directly. (microsoft)
- [Tag test codeunits with FEATURE, SCENARIO, GIVEN, WHEN, and THEN comments](microsoft/knowledge/testing/test-feature-scenario-tags.md): Test codeunits are easier to trust and to review when they carry a four-level comment structure taken from Behaviour-/Acceptance-Test-Driven Development: \[FEATURE\] once at the top of the codeunit naming the functional area under test, \[SCENARIO\] above each test procedure stating one falsifiable… (microsoft)
- [Use Assert.IsFalse to check a boolean result, not asserterror around Assert.IsTrue](microsoft/knowledge/testing/use-assert-isfalse-not-asserterror-for-boolean-checks.md): asserterror exists to assert that a statement raises a runtime error; it is not a general-purpose way to invert a boolean check. (microsoft)
- [Verify field editability with TestPage.Editable(), opened in edit mode](microsoft/knowledge/testing/use-testpage-editable-to-verify-field-editability.md): Whether a field can actually be changed is a distinct state from whether it is shown or enabled — Editable() and Enabled() are separate TestField functions. (microsoft)
- [Verify field visibility and enabled state with TestPage.Visible()/.Enabled()](microsoft/knowledge/testing/use-testpage-visible-enabled-to-verify-field-ui-state.md): A UI test codeunit does not need to inspect table or page properties indirectly to confirm a field is shown or enabled under given conditions. (microsoft)
- [Wire UI handlers and verify meaningful outcomes](microsoft/knowledge/testing/ui-handlers-in-tests.md): A test runs headless, so every UI call on the executed path must be intercepted by a matching handler named in \[HandlerFunctions(...)\]. (microsoft)

## web-services

- [Address API records by SystemId, not by a renamable business key](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/expose-systemid-as-the-api-key.md): Every BC table carries a SystemId — an immutable GUID assigned at insert and never reused. (microsoft)
- [Check for JSON null before converting a value](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/check-json-null-before-converting-values.md): An optional property in a JSON payload can be missing or present with the value null, and the two cases behave differently in AL. (microsoft)
- [Check HTTP status before consuming the response body](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/check-http-status-before-consuming-response-body.md): A successful AL HttpClient call only confirms that the platform completed the HTTP exchange. (microsoft)
- [Declare API routing properties and an explicit stable version](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/set-required-api-page-properties.md): An API page needs APIPublisher, APIGroup, EntityName, EntitySetName, and a backing SourceTable to define its routed entity. (microsoft)
- [Expose business operations as bound actions, not as writable status flags](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/expose-operations-as-bound-actions.md): An API consumer that needs to *do* something to a record — post it, ship it, release it — should call an explicit operation, not mutate a field and hope a side effect fires. (microsoft)
- [Format exchanged values with standard format 9](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/format-exchanged-values-with-standard-format-9.md): Format(Value) uses standard format 0, the display format, and follows the current user's regional settings. (microsoft)
- [Give API pages least-privilege write access](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/api-page-least-privilege-write-access.md): A general-purpose API page that exposes many fields should not be widened to allow writes on one additional field. (microsoft)
- [Handle HttpClient platform failure before accessing the response](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/handle-httpclient-platform-failure-before-response-access.md): AL HttpClient methods can fail before a usable HTTP response exists because of an invalid request, DNS or network failure, certificate validation, timeout, a disabled extension setting, or the response-size limit. (microsoft)
- [Keep Consumer-Provided Key Fields Editable on API Pages](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/api-page-key-fields-must-be-editable-on-insert.md): A field listed in ODataKeyFields cannot have Editable = false when the API page allows inserts and the field's value must be supplied by the caller. (microsoft)
- [Link API parts on SystemId and choose the correct multiplicity](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/link-api-parts-on-systemid-and-set-multiplicity.md): Multiplicity is available from runtime 6.3 (Business Central 17.3) and defaults an API page part to a 1:N collection. (microsoft)
- [Lock down write operations on read-only API pages](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/disable-write-operations-on-read-only-api-pages.md): An API meant purely for reading — a reporting or lookup endpoint — is not read-only just because nobody intends to write to it. (microsoft)
- [Read only committed data from APIs that must not expose in-flight writes](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/expose-only-committed-data-from-api-reads.md): This is about the data-consistency contract of an API endpoint: what a consumer receives when it reads. (microsoft)
- [Recalculate Stored Derived Fields Before Exposing Them on API Pages](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/stored-derived-fields-must-not-be-exposed-directly.md): A stored field whose value is derived from other fields inside an OnValidate trigger only updates when that specific trigger fires. (microsoft)
- [Set the text encoding when converting exchanged text to or from BLOB bytes](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/set-text-encoding-on-streams-exchanged-externally.md): Blob.CreateInStream and Blob.CreateOutStream take an optional TextEncoding; when it is omitted, the stream uses MSDos (OEM) encoding, whose code page depends on the server's system locale. (microsoft)
- [Under OData schema version 2.0 an API enum field is a contract by member name; under 1.0 it is the caption](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/api-enum-values-are-a-contract-by-name-not-ordinal.md): What an API page publishes for an enum field depends on the OData $schemaversion the caller receives, and never on the ordinal. (microsoft)
- [Verify webhook eligibility and complete every validationToken handshake](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/webhook-eligibility-and-validationtoken-renewal.md): Business Central can subscribe only to eligible API pages, not every endpoint that can be read through an API. (microsoft)
- [Version changed API shapes with a new page object](microsoft/knowledge/web-services/version-apis-by-adding-not-mutating-published-versions.md): Once an API version is published, external clients depend on its exact shape — entity names, fields, keys, and behavior — as a stable contract. (microsoft)

## reporting

- [A layout added in a report extension is not used until it is selected](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/reportextension-layouts-are-not-selected-automatically.md): A reportextension can add layouts through its rendering section, but deploying the extension does not make any of them the report's layout. (microsoft)
- [Choose ReportExtension dataitem triggers by their order around the base trigger](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/reportextension-dataitem-trigger-order-is-explicit.md): ReportExtension dataitem triggers run at defined points around the corresponding base-report trigger. (microsoft)
- [Clear a Report variable before an independent RunModal execution](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/clear-report-variable-before-independent-runmodal.md): Report.Run() automatically clears the report variable after execution, but Report.RunModal() does not. (microsoft)
- [CurrReport.Break ends the current trigger](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/currreport-break-ends-the-current-trigger.md): CurrReport.Break() inside a report dataitem trigger does more than leave an AL loop. (microsoft)
- [CurrReport.Quit rolls back report changes and skips OnPostReport](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/currreport-quit-rolls-back-and-skips-onpostreport.md): CurrReport.Quit() aborts the report without committing database changes made during its execution. (microsoft)
- [CurrReport.Skip omits the record but does not stop trigger code](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/currreport-skip-does-not-stop-trigger-code.md): CurrReport.Skip() omits the current record from the report dataset and continues processing with the next record. (microsoft)
- [Declare report layouts in the rendering section, not with the legacy layout properties](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/declare-report-layouts-in-the-rendering-section.md): Since runtime 9.0 (BC20), reports declare layouts in a rendering section of named layout entries, each with Type, LayoutFile, Caption, and Summary, and choose the default by name with DefaultRenderingLayout. (microsoft)
- [Do not rename or remove columns of a report dataset that has shipped](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/do-not-rename-or-remove-shipped-report-dataset-columns.md): A report's dataset column names are the contract that every layout binds to, including layouts that are not in your source code. (microsoft)
- [Report output in a loop needs one client download](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/report-output-in-a-loop-needs-one-client-download.md): The Business Central Web client can deliver only one file per request. (microsoft)
- [ReportExtension report triggers run after base report triggers](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/reportextension-report-triggers-run-after-base-triggers.md): OnPreReport and OnPostReport on a ReportExtension run after the corresponding triggers on the base report. (microsoft)
- [SetTableView cannot broaden DataItemTableView](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/settableview-cannot-broaden-dataitemtableview.md): Report.SetTableView() applies the supplied record view by narrowing the view already defined by the report dataitem's DataItemTableView. (microsoft)
- [Stop when RunRequestPage returns empty parameters](microsoft/knowledge/reporting/stop-when-runrequestpage-returns-empty-parameters.md): Report.RunRequestPage() returns an empty string when the user chooses Cancel. (microsoft)

## error-handling

- [A declined `Confirm` in `OnValidate` must abort or revert, not skip a required side effect](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/declined-confirm-must-abort-not-partially-apply.md): By the time a field's OnValidate body runs, the field already holds its new value. (microsoft)
- [An unchecked Record.Get raises an error when the record is missing; it is not silently ignored](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/unchecked-get-throws-when-record-not-found.md): Record.Get returns a Boolean, but its behavior when no record is found depends on whether the return value is consumed. (microsoft)
- [Choose `TestField` For Conditional Checks And `FieldError` For Already-Failed Validation](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/fielderror-vs-testfield.md): TestField and FieldError look interchangeable but behave differently, and choosing the wrong one produces either dead code or a check that never fires. (microsoft)
- [Collect validation errors with ErrorBehavior::Collect and handle the collected list](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/collect-validation-errors-with-errorbehavior.md): By default a procedure stops on the first Error, so a user fixing ten bad rows must rerun the operation ten times. (microsoft)
- [Consume a TryFunction return value to enable try semantics](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/ignored-tryfunction-return-disables-try-semantics.md): A procedure marked \[TryFunction\] catches errors only when the caller uses its Boolean return value. (microsoft)
- [Log writes that must capture failures must survive transaction rollback](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/log-writes-must-survive-rollback.md): Inserting a log record inside the same transaction as the operation it logs looks correct until the operation errors: the transaction rolls back and takes the log entry with it. (microsoft)
- [Match defensive vs. offensive error handling to the blast radius of being wrong](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/defensive-vs-offensive-code-must-match-blast-radius.md): Whether code should guard gracefully (defensive) or fail loudly (offensive/fail-fast) is not a matter of habit or a blanket house style — it depends on what happens downstream if the guarded condition is silently defaulted or skipped. (microsoft)
- [Page record triggers return true by default; a missing exit(true) does not block the operation](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/page-boolean-triggers-default-to-true.md): The Boolean page record triggers OnInsertRecord, OnModifyRecord, OnDeleteRecord, and OnQueryClosePage return true by default. (microsoft)
- [Prefer ErrorInfo with recommended actions over a plain Error for recoverable failures](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/prefer-errorinfo-for-actionable-errors.md): A plain Error('text') ends the operation with a dead-end dialog: the user reads the message but the system offers no way forward. (microsoft)
- [Rely On FieldError's Auto-Generated Context And Pass Only A Lowercase Predicate](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/fielderror-default-message-logic.md): Rec.FieldError(FieldNo) does not just print the text you give it. (microsoft)
- [Set ErrorInfo.ErrorType to Internal for defects you want in telemetry but not in the user's face](microsoft/knowledge/error-handling/errortype-internal-vs-client-for-diagnostics.md): ErrorInfo.ErrorType controls where an error's message is shown. (microsoft)

## appsource

- [AppSource permission sets must cover setup and usage without SUPER](microsoft/knowledge/appsource/permission-sets-cover-setup-and-usage-without-super.md): An AppSource app must provide permission sets that let assigned users complete the app's setup and normal usage without SUPER. (microsoft)
- [Define profiles as AL objects](community/knowledge/appsource/define-profiles-as-al-objects.md): Profiles delivered by a Marketplace extension must be declared as AL profile objects. (community)
- [Do not hard-code time-zone offsets](community/knowledge/appsource/do-not-hard-code-time-zone-offsets.md): Marketplace extensions run for users and services in many time zones. (community)
- [Keep the Copilot help URL to two path levels](microsoft/knowledge/appsource/keep-copilot-help-url-to-two-path-levels.md): The help URL declared in app.json is what Copilot uses to ground answers about your app. (microsoft)
- [Keep web-service paths free of UI calls](community/knowledge/appsource/keep-web-service-paths-free-of-ui-calls.md): Pages and codeunits exposed as web services run without an interactive client. (community)
- [Place page extension actions with addfirst or addlast](community/knowledge/appsource/place-page-extension-actions-with-addfirst-or-addlast.md): Place new page-extension actions at the beginning or end of an existing action group with addfirst or addlast. (community)
- [Set UsageCategory on searchable entry points](community/knowledge/appsource/set-usagecategory-on-searchable-entry-points.md): Pages and reports that users are expected to open directly must set UsageCategory. (community)
- [The File data type's direct I/O methods are OnPrem-only](microsoft/knowledge/appsource/file-datatype-saas.md): The classic File variable type — Open/Create/Read/Write/Close against a path on the local or server filesystem — is scoped OnPrem-only. (microsoft)
- [Update the app version at every release](microsoft/knowledge/appsource/release-must-update-app-version.md): At every release — a branch merged to main, a tagged release build, or an AppSource submission — the app's version is consciously updated, not left to the pipeline alone. (microsoft)
- [Use invariant date literals](community/knowledge/appsource/use-invariant-date-literals.md): Write fixed dates in AL with the invariant yyyymmddD syntax. (community)

## scm

- [Cancel reservations through reservation management](microsoft/knowledge/scm/cancel-reservations-through-reservation-management.md): Persistent "Reservation Entry" rows are not disposable allocation markers. (microsoft)
- [Carry out requisition actions through the standard workflow](microsoft/knowledge/scm/carry-out-requisition-actions-through-the-standard-workflow.md): A requisition/planning line is a pending change to a supply/demand network, not just a template for a purchase line. (microsoft)
- [Change item applications through posting routines](microsoft/knowledge/scm/change-item-applications-through-posting-routines.md): An "Item Application Entry" connects quantity application to cost flow; changing its inbound entry number is not merely fixing a foreign key. (microsoft)
- [Derive base quantities through the line's unit of measure](microsoft/knowledge/scm/derive-base-quantities-through-the-line-unit-of-measure.md): Inventory, item ledger entries, reservations, item tracking, and warehouse quantities are measured in the item's base unit of measure. (microsoft)
- [Post calculated revaluation through the item journal batch](microsoft/knowledge/scm/post-revaluation-through-the-item-journal-batch.md): A calculated revaluation line with nonblank "Inventory Value Per" represents an aggregate, not a finalized posting against one item ledger entry. (microsoft)
- [Post item ledger changes through item journals](microsoft/knowledge/scm/post-item-ledger-changes-through-item-journals.md): An item ledger entry is not an independently insertable stock balance. (microsoft)
- [Post transfers through shipment and receipt codeunits](microsoft/knowledge/scm/post-transfers-through-shipment-and-receipt-codeunits.md): A two-step transfer order preserves a continuous quantity, reservation, and cost/application lineage from the source through in-transit to the destination. (microsoft)
- [Reconcile warehouse adjustments with the item ledger](microsoft/knowledge/scm/reconcile-warehouse-adjustments-with-the-item-ledger.md): At a Directed Put-away and Pick location, registering an ordinary warehouse quantity or physical-inventory adjustment and synchronizing it to inventory are distinct steps. (microsoft)
- [Transfer item tracking through source reservation codeunits](microsoft/knowledge/scm/transfer-item-tracking-through-source-reservation-codeunits.md): Moving lot/serial tracking between document lines is a source-ownership operation, not a copy of visible tracking fields. (microsoft)
- [Use date-aware availability for promising](microsoft/knowledge/scm/use-date-aware-availability-for-promising.md): Item.Inventory is an on-hand quantity, not an available-to-promise answer. (microsoft)

## breaking-changes

- [Changing an unreleased symbol is not a breaking change](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/unreleased-symbol-change-is-not-a-breaking-change.md): Breaking-change rules protect contracts that have already shipped to customers or are exposed to external extensions. (microsoft)
- [Choose access modifiers deliberately](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/choose-access-modifiers-deliberately.md): Access is a decision about what you are willing to support forever. (microsoft)
- [Deprecate public members through the Obsolete lifecycle, never delete them outright](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/deprecate-public-members-with-the-obsolete-lifecycle.md): Deleting or renaming a published procedure (or object) in a single release is a hard break: dependent extensions that reference it stop compiling the moment they pick up the new version, with no warning window to migrate. (microsoft)
- [Do not build on code already marked obsolete](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/do-not-modify-code-already-marked-obsolete.md): A member carrying \[Obsolete\], or wrapped in a #if not CLEANxx conditional-compilation block, is already scheduled for deletion — the CLEANxx symbol is flipped on in a future release to strip that code out. (microsoft)
- [Do not change the signature of a published procedure](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/do-not-change-published-procedure-signatures.md): A procedure that is reachable from outside its object — any procedure not marked local (and, for on-prem-scoped code, anything a dependent app can still bind to) — is a contract. (microsoft)
- [Do not widen access to expose sensitive data through a public API](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/do-not-expose-sensitive-data-through-public-api.md): Every member you make publicly reachable becomes a contract you must keep — and when that member returns a secret, the contract leaks the secret. (microsoft)
- [Obsolete published table fields instead of deleting, renaming, or renumbering them](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/obsolete-table-fields-instead-of-deleting-them.md): A shipped table field carries both a source-level contract and persisted data. (microsoft)
- [Relocating a field to a tableextension in the same app is not a deletion](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/relocating-a-field-to-a-tableextension-is-not-a-deletion.md): Moving a field out of a base-table definition (or a base-app layer modification of one) into a tableextension that extends the same table, within the same app and keeping the same field ID and name, is a relocation — not a deletion or a rename. (microsoft)
- [Send email through the Email module, not Codeunit Mail (397)](microsoft/knowledge/breaking-changes/prefer-email-module.md): Older AL code sends email by calling Codeunit Mail (397). (microsoft)

## finance

- [Apply and unapply entries through the application workflow, not status flags](microsoft/knowledge/finance/apply-ledger-entries-through-application-codeunits.md): Customer/vendor settlement is a posting operation involving detailed ledger entries, not just a change to Open on the main entry. (microsoft)
- [Change a transaction's dimension set reference, not a shared set's membership](microsoft/knowledge/finance/do-not-edit-shared-dimension-sets.md): The same Dimension Set ID can be referenced by an unposted journal line and by many already-posted entries. (microsoft)
- [Change posted customer/vendor due dates through the entry-edit workflow](microsoft/knowledge/finance/change-ledger-due-dates-through-entry-edit.md): A posted customer or vendor due date is supported editable operational data, but it is also represented by Initial Entry Due Date on related detailed ledger entries. (microsoft)
- [Copy complete posting dimension sets, not only shortcut projections](microsoft/knowledge/finance/write-dimensions-as-dimension-set-entries.md): When a journal line or posting document inherits dimensions, its Dimension Set ID identifies the complete combination of Dimension Set Entry rows. (microsoft)
- [Correct posted financial content through posting workflows, not row surgery](microsoft/knowledge/finance/do-not-modify-or-delete-posted-ledger-entries.md): Changing a posted entry's original amount, account, posting date, or tax amounts in place does not correct the related ledger, register, or source document. (microsoft)
- [Create financial ledger entries through the owning posting engine](microsoft/knowledge/finance/post-ledger-entries-through-posting-codeunits.md): Standard financial ledger entries are outputs of posting, not independent rows an extension manufactures. (microsoft)
- [Pass the transaction number, not a ledger-entry number, to ReverseTransaction](microsoft/knowledge/finance/reverse-transactions-by-transaction-number.md): Reversal Entry.ReverseTransaction expects a transaction number, while ReverseRegister expects a G/L register number. (microsoft)
- [Preserve the journal batch's document-balancing policy](microsoft/knowledge/finance/preserve-journal-batch-document-balance.md): A balanced G/L total does not prove that a general-journal batch satisfies its template's document-balancing policy. (microsoft)
- [Supply a VAT-inclusive journal Amount for automatic Normal VAT](microsoft/knowledge/finance/normal-vat-journal-amount-includes-vat.md): For a general-journal line using Automatic VAT Entry and Normal VAT, Amount includes VAT. (microsoft)

## telemetry

- [Call FeatureTelemetry.LogUsage only after successful use](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/feature-usage-only-after-success.md): FeatureTelemetry.LogUsage means that a user successfully used the feature. (microsoft)
- [Choose TelemetryScope by who must receive the signal](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/choose-telemetry-scope-by-audience.md): TelemetryScope::ExtensionPublisher sends a custom trace only to the Application Insights resource configured by the extension publisher. (microsoft)
- [Emit FeatureTelemetry uptake states in lifecycle order](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/feature-uptake-transitions-in-order.md): FeatureTelemetry.LogUptake accepts Discovered, Set up, Used, and Undiscovered, but the platform records the forward transition only as Discovered to Set up to Used. (microsoft)
- [Match telemetry Verbosity to the signal's actual severity](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/match-verbosity-to-signal-severity.md): Verbosity becomes the Application Insights severityLevel and participates in on-premises diagnostic trace filtering. (microsoft)
- [Register exactly one Telemetry Logger implementation per publisher](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/register-one-telemetry-logger-per-publisher.md): The Telemetry and Feature Telemetry codeunits reach an extension publisher's telemetry through an implementation of the "Telemetry Logger" interface registered with "Telemetry Loggers".OnRegisterTelemetryLogger. (microsoft)
- [Telemetry event IDs must be stable, unique, and non-placeholder](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/telemetry-event-id-stable-unique.md): The first parameter of Session.LogMessage is the event ID. (microsoft)
- [Treat custom dimension keys as a stable telemetry schema](microsoft/knowledge/telemetry/keep-custom-dimension-schema-stable.md): Business Central prefixes AL custom-dimension keys with al in Application Insights, so an AL key named Result becomes alResult. (microsoft)

## interfaces

- [Assign a codeunit to an interface variable for injectable, testable dependencies](microsoft/knowledge/interfaces/assign-codeunit-to-interface-for-testability.md): An interface variable can hold any codeunit that implements the interface, assigned directly — no enum is required. (microsoft)
- [Extend published interfaces; do not edit them](microsoft/knowledge/interfaces/extend-published-interfaces-dont-edit-them.md): Adding a method to a shipped interface changes the contract every implementing codeunit must satisfy. (microsoft)
- [Guard optional interface casts with `is`](microsoft/knowledge/interfaces/guard-interface-casts-with-is.md): From runtime 15.0, AL can type-test an interface or Variant with is and cast it to another interface with as. (microsoft)
- [Handle unknown enum ordinals with UnknownValueImplementation](microsoft/knowledge/interfaces/handle-unknown-enum-ordinals-with-unknownvalueimplementation.md): An enum ordinal can remain in persisted data after the enum extension that declared it is uninstalled. (microsoft)
- [Prefer an interface with enum-backed implementation over a case statement for variant behaviour](microsoft/knowledge/interfaces/prefer-interface-over-case-branching.md): When behaviour varies by a discrete "type" — a shipping method, a posting strategy, a payment provider — the obvious first draft is a case over an enum with one branch per variant. (microsoft)
- [Set DefaultImplementation on an enum so an unmapped value still resolves to an interface](microsoft/knowledge/interfaces/set-defaultimplementation-on-enum.md): An enum that implements an interface maps each declared value to a codeunit through the Implementation property. (microsoft)

## query

- [A lower query data item without SqlJoinType is a left outer join](microsoft/knowledge/query/query-dataitems-default-to-left-outer-join.md): When a lower dataitem in a query sets DataItemLink but omits SqlJoinType, the join is LeftOuterJoin. (microsoft)
- [DataItemTableFilter cannot be overwritten at runtime](microsoft/knowledge/query/dataitemtablefilter-cannot-be-overwritten-at-runtime.md): DataItemTableFilter defines a static filter on a Query dataitem. (microsoft)
- [Every non-aggregated query column is a group key](microsoft/knowledge/query/every-non-aggregated-query-column-is-a-group-key.md): As soon as one query column sets Method to Sum, Count, Average, Min, or Max, the query groups its result by all other columns, including columns of other data items and columns that use a date method (Day, Month, Year). (microsoft)
- [Reopening a Query resets its cursor but keeps its filters](microsoft/knowledge/query/reopening-query-resets-cursor-but-keeps-filters.md): Calling Open() on an already open query first closes the current dataset and opens it again. (microsoft)
- [Set Query filters before Open](microsoft/knowledge/query/set-query-filters-before-open.md): Query.SetFilter and Query.SetRange automatically close an open query dataset. (microsoft)
- [SetFilter and SetRange overwrite Query ColumnFilter](microsoft/knowledge/query/setfilter-overwrites-query-columnfilter.md): ColumnFilter on a Query column or filter row defines a dynamic filter. (microsoft)

## copilot

- [Call Azure OpenAI through the System.AI module, not a hand-built HttpClient request](community/knowledge/copilot/call-azure-openai-through-the-ai-module.md): The System Application's AI module (Azure OpenAI, AOAI Chat Messages, AOAI Chat Completion Params, AOAI Operation Response) is the supported way to call Azure OpenAI from AL. (community)
- [Check the AOAI Operation Response before using generated output](community/knowledge/copilot/check-aoai-operation-response-before-using-output.md): GenerateChatCompletion, GenerateTextCompletion, and GenerateEmbeddings in codeunit Azure OpenAI report the outcome of the service call in the AOAI Operation Response passed by var; a failed completion does not stop the AL code. (community)
- [Keep user input and record text out of the system message](community/knowledge/copilot/keep-user-input-out-of-the-system-message.md): AOAI Chat Messages separates roles: the system message (SetPrimarySystemMessage, AddSystemMessage) holds the metaprompt that defines the model's task, output format, and guard rails; user messages (AddUserMessage) carry what the user typed and the business data to work on. (community)
- [Register a Copilot capability on install and on upgrade](community/knowledge/copilot/register-copilot-capability-on-install-and-upgrade.md): Every extension that calls the AI module must register its Copilot Capability enum value with codeunit Copilot Capability; using a capability that the calling extension has not registered raises an error. (community)
- [Save PromptDialog proposals only when the user keeps them](community/knowledge/copilot/save-promptdialog-proposals-only-when-the-user-keeps-them.md): A PromptDialog page shows AI-generated content as a proposal. (community)

- [AL telemetry review](microsoft/skills/review/al-telemetry-review.md): Performs an AL telemetry review against guidance from BCQuality. (microsoft)
- [AL testing review](microsoft/skills/review/al-testing-review.md): Performs an AL testing review against guidance from BCQuality. (microsoft)
- [AL UI and accessibility review](microsoft/skills/review/al-ui-review.md): Reviews AL page and control add-in UI files, and AL code that sends or recalls notifications, against UI text, caption, tooltip, notification, and accessibility guidance from BCQuality. (microsoft)
- [AL upgrade review](microsoft/skills/review/al-upgrade-review.md): Reviews AL source changes against upgrade-code and migration guidance from BCQuality. (microsoft)
- [AL web services review](microsoft/skills/review/al-web-services-review.md): Reviews AL API surfaces, outbound HTTP integrations, and webhook handlers against web-services guidance from BCQuality. (microsoft)
